etymology.historical_story: The Malaysian spelling epal shows how an English fruit name can receive a Malay spelling while retaining its familiar meaning. Apple also functions as a company name: the business was founded in 1976. Context and capitalization therefore separate a fruit word from a technology brand, even though their English pronunciation is the same. See [DBP's spelling guide](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf) and [Apple's founding history](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/03/apple-to-celebrate-50-years-of-thinking-different/).

etymology.historical_story: Angelina ialah bentuk nama manja bagi Angela, nama yang berkaitan dengan kata Latin angelus, yakni malaikat. Hubungan sejarah itu menerangkan asal nama, bukan memberikan makna kamus Melayu kepada setiap orang yang bernama Angelina. Dalam ayat Melayu, nama ini berfungsi seperti nama peribadi lain: mengenal pasti seseorang dan dikekalkan sebagai satu bentuk lengkap. [Etymonline: Angelina](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Angelina)

etymology.historical_story: This English compound combines ass, referring to the buttocks, with hole. Its literal anatomical meaning is older than its familiar use as a personal insult; Merriam-Webster dates the word's earliest known use to the fourteenth century. It also acquired a contemptuous geographical sense. These are developments within English, not evidence of Malay derivation. See [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/asshole).

etymology.historical_story: Arkham belongs to the imagined geography of H. P. Lovecraft's fiction. Its recurring appearance gives separate stories a shared setting and makes a fictional Massachusetts town feel familiar to readers. That literary identity explains the name's cultural associations; it does not establish a Malay etymology or justify dividing the name into Malay affixes. [Reference: Arkham](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arkham).

senses.nuances: 属于 kata nama khas（专有名词），不是可直接翻译为某种性格或品质的普通名词。没有上下文时不能据此识别某位具体人物。此处马来语释义为编辑性说明，并非 DBP 原文。名字及其拉丁语来源见 [瑞典语言与民俗研究所](https://www.isof.se/utforska/kunskapsbanker/lar-dig-mer-om-arets-namn-och-handelser/namn/adrian)。以下搭配是常用称呼结构，不代表经过频率统计的固定搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Adrian belongs to an international naming tradition rather than Malay word formation. It continues Latin Hadrianus, a name associated with a place called Hadria. Its history illustrates how a geographical association can become a personal name and travel between languages. In Malay writing, it remains a capitalized name. [Source: Institute for Language and Folklore](https://www.isof.se/utforska/kunskapsbanker/lar-dig-mer-om-arets-namn-och-handelser/namn/adrian).

etymology.historical_story: Ajay belongs to a South Asian naming tradition linked to Sanskrit ajaya, associated with being unconquered. That historical meaning helps explain the name, but it does not turn Ajay into a Malay adjective meaning invincible. In a Malay sentence, the name identifies a person. Without the original corpus passage or the person's own pronunciation, neither a specific identity nor a single authoritative pronunciation can be established. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/ajay)

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 是附着代词，不是普通派生后缀；此处依字段选项归入 suffix。ny 表示单一鼻音 /ɲ/，词根不变。headword.jawi 按资料包保留 ambil 的拼写；完整 ambilnya 写作 امبيلڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 拿它、取它或领取它；-nya 回指上下文已经提到的人或事物，具体动作由语境决定。
senses.en_definition: Take, fetch, or collect it, him, or her, with the referent supplied by context.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk ambil yang diikuti kata ganti nama terikat -nya, merujuk kepada orang atau benda yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: 这不是独立的新词义，也不表示过去时。释义是根据 ambil 与附着代词 -nya 作出的语法说明，并非 DBP 对 ambilnya 的独立释条。现代正式主动陈述通常写 mengambilnya；日常交流常重复具体名词，如 ambil fail itu。不能把所有位置的 -nya 都译成“它”：diambilnya 中可指施事“由他／她”，历史文本也须另依句法判断。参见 [DBP：ambil](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=ambil+hati)及 [DBP 拼写指南](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: A Kedah government record dated 11 January 1916 contains ambilnya tanah in its Malay-Jawi title for a proposed road's land acquisition. This documents an older administrative use, not the date the form originated. It also shows why historical ambilnya must be read in context rather than automatically translated as the modern object expression “take it.” See [Arkib Negara Malaysia](https://ofa.arkib.gov.my/ofa/collection/asset/455494).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ambil＝拿；-nya 像贴在词尾的回指标签。先找它指谁，再翻译整个句子。

etymology.historical_story: America appeared on Martin Waldseemüller’s 1507 world map in recognition of the voyages of Amerigo Vespucci. The name initially appeared over land now identified as South America, rather than naming the later United States. This history helps explain why modern usage can refer either to a broad geographical region or, in everyday speech, to one country. [Library of Congress](https://blogs.loc.gov/loc/2016/07/how-did-america-get-its-name/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Amerigo → America → 马来语 Amerika；说美国，补上 Syarikat 最明确。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语短语的首字母缩写，在此按不可再作马来语词缀拆分的词项处理。通常写作 AI，并逐字母读英语字母名；不是把 a、i 当成词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 人工智能；研究及实现机器学习、推理、感知等通常与人类智能相关能力的领域、技术或系统。
senses.en_definition: Artificial intelligence: the field, technology, or systems concerned with machine capabilities such as learning, reasoning, and perception.
senses.ms_definition: Singkatan bagi artificial intelligence, iaitu kecerdasan buatan: bidang, teknologi atau sistem yang membolehkan mesin menjalankan tugas seperti pembelajaran, penaakulan dan persepsi.
senses.nuances: 按输入保留小写词目 ai；现代科技文本通常写 AI。此处只处理词包指定的人工智能缩写义。音标采用常见英语字母名读法；syllables 的 ai 是原始词包字段，不表示实际口语只读一个音节。AI 不专指聊天机器人或生成式模型。[DBP 术语释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=Kecerdasan+Buatan+Artificial+Intelligence+AI)

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于教育、职场、新闻及日常科技讨论。聊天中写 AI 很自然；在学业或工作成果中说明 AI 的具体用途，有助于让对方理解实际由谁完成了哪些工作。

etymology.historical_story: AI preserves the initials of the English phrase artificial intelligence. That phrase appeared in the 1955 proposal for a summer research project at Dartmouth in 1956. Malay uses the equivalent kecerdasan buatan while also retaining AI, allowing the international abbreviation and the Malay descriptive term to function together. [Original proposal](https://www-formal.stanford.edu/jmc/history/dartmouth/dartmouth.html)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: A = artificial（人工的），I = intelligence（智能）；合起来 AI = kecerdasan buatan。记英语字母名读音，正式书写用大写。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为外语专名整体使用。词尾 -a 不是此词的马来语后缀；不要按照马来语 ng 的通常读法机械推导整个名字的读音。

etymology.historical_story: Angela ultimately traces to the Greek word angelos, meaning messenger, but its development as a feminine name was indirect. Oxford's Lexicon of Greek Personal Names notes that Angela was not used as a female name in antiquity. Its historical association with messengers therefore explains a naming tradition, not an ordinary Malay meaning. [Oxford LGPN](https://lgpn.web.ox.ac.uk/greek-names-english)

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve argus alongside the animal names tikus belanda and marmut. This cluster illustrates how one animal can carry several conventional names within a language. The supplied evidence does not establish the historical source of argus, so a connection with Greek mythology or similarly spelled bird names should not be assumed.

etymology.historical_story: Angkasawan illustrates how Malay builds modern vocabulary from familiar material: angkasa supplies the idea of space, while -wan identifies a person associated with a field. Space exploration gives this formation its specialist meaning. The parallel angkasawati uses -wati to identify a woman astronaut, illustrating a borrowed suffix pattern taught in Malay word formation. See [DBP's word-formation discussion](https://jendeladbp.my/app/uploads/woocommerce_uploads/2022/07/DEWAN-SISWA-OGOS-2022-compressed-e5h3j9.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: English anyway combines any and way, but its present meanings extend beyond a literal choice of route. Dictionaries distinguish persistence despite circumstances from conversational uses that redirect, resume, or qualify a point. In a Malay sentence, retaining this English form represents code-switching rather than Malay affixation. Its conversational function explains why a single fixed Malay translation often fails.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 anyway 想成谈话的转向灯：句首常“话说回来”，行动后常“还是照做”。不要固定背成一个马来语连接词。

morphology.pattern_note: 加后缀 -an 构成集合性名词，表示各种工具或器材；词根末尾的 t 保留，并与后面的元音连读。此处 -an 不表示动作反复。

etymology.historical_story: Alatan illustrates a productive Malay way of naming a collection: alat identifies a tool, while the suffix -an forms a noun covering assorted implements. The dictionary's example places alatan alongside room decorations, showing that its scope extends beyond workshop tools. Modern combinations such as alatan memasak and alatan elektronik connect this collective meaning with familiar domestic and technical activities.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 alat＝工具，再把 -an 想成装工具的篮子：alatan＝一篮子各式器材。这是记忆画面。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -kan 直接接在 andai 后，双元音 /ai̯/ 保留。在动词祈使结构中，andaikan 对应 mengandaikan 去掉 meN- 的形式；作假设连接语时，整体表示“假如”。

senses.zh_definition: 假如；假设；引出尚未确定为事实或与事实相反的条件。
senses.en_definition: Supposing that; if; introducing a hypothetical or counterfactual condition.
senses.ms_definition: Misalnya, katakanlah, sekiranya, seumpamanya, andai kata.
senses.nuances: 引导设想的条件，不表示说话人确认该情况属实。可讨论未来可能发生的情况，也可配合 dulu 等时间词表达过去的反事实条件；具体时间关系由上下文决定。日常聊天更常用 kalau。[DBP：andai](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=andai)

senses.zh_definition: 试设想；先假定某种情况成立，以便推理或讨论。
senses.en_definition: Assume or imagine a situation for the purpose of reasoning or discussion.
senses.ms_definition: Menganggap mungkin terjadi, memisalkan, mengumpamakan.
senses.nuances: 这里是 mengandaikan 的祈使形式，例如 Andaikan bahawa...。马来文释义取自 DBP 对 mengandaikan 的解释；词包中 andaikan 的直接释义主要对应上一项连接语用法。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary groups andaikan with andainya and seandainya under andai, a word associated with examples and suppositions. This family gives Malay several ways to open an imagined situation. A speaker can invite someone to assume a premise, then reason from it. The same device supports classroom problems, practical planning, and reflections on how an earlier decision might have changed events.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 andai 记作“假设”，-kan 像把假设推到眼前：andaikan＝“先假设一下”。不按汉语谐音推断词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 分音节为 a.wek；e 为 é 音，不是央元音 ə，词尾 k 通常实现为喉塞音 [ʔ]。重叠形式 awek-awek 不涉及词缀添加。

word_family.gloss: 姑娘们；多个年轻女子，口语

senses.zh_definition: 姑娘；年轻女子。用于非正式谈话的称呼或指称，本身不表示恋爱关系。
senses.en_definition: A girl or young woman, referred to informally.
senses.ms_definition: Panggilan yang biasa dihubungkan dengan seorang gadis.
senses.nuances: 输入包所引《Kamus Dewan》标为 bp，即 bahasa percakapan。词典收录不等于适合正式称呼；是否带轻佻意味取决于语境、语气及双方关系，也不应限定为某一族群的女子。

senses.zh_definition: 女朋友；女性恋人。属于熟人之间的口语说法。

senses.nuances: awek aku 等所属结构通常指女朋友，而非一般女性朋友；正式表达宜用 teman wanita。此义有马来西亚语言研究的实际用例支持，参见 [UKM 语言研究](https://spaj.ukm.my/jws/index.php/jws/article/download/47/26)。

etymology.historical_story: The supplied Kamus Dewan entry records awek as a colloquial designation for a girl. Malaysian research also documents its use for a girlfriend in youth slang and fiction. These records establish its social meanings, but do not establish a secure historical derivation; a specific origin story would therefore be speculative. [Source: UKM study](https://spaj.ukm.my/jws/index.php/jws/article/download/47/26).

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 赛事报道首次出现时可解释为 aka（红方选手），方便普通读者理解。表示别名时，使用当事人认可的艺名或昵称；正式介绍宜写 juga dikenali sebagai。马来语日常表示红色仍用 merah。

etymology.historical_story: Karate carries Japanese colour labels into competition terminology: aka identifies the red side, while shiro identifies the white side in the Japan Karate Association rules. Malay sports terminology retains aka as a name for the red competitor. Separately, English aka abbreviates also known as. These identical spellings represent different origins and pronunciations, so a red-side competitor and an alias marker should be learned separately. [JKA tournament rules](https://www.jka.or.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/Tournament-Rules-Regulations-Text-2015rev.pdf) [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-malaysian/a-k-a)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 体育义读“阿卡”：想象裁判喊 aka，红方选手上场。别名义看三个首字母：A＝also，K＝known，A＝as → 又名。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根以元音 a 起首，接 meN-、peN- 时分别采用 meng-、peng-；é 表示 /e/。词根主要见于派生词。

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan labels this word Jk, connecting its recorded usage with Jakarta Malay. Its derivatives describe musicians moving between houses and include a reference to a keroncong troupe. That cultural setting helps explain the vocabulary, but the supplied evidence does not establish an earlier donor language or a secure ancient origin.

etymology.historical_story: Aplikasi belongs to the international vocabulary of application and practical use. Its dictionary meaning connects ideas with action: knowledge becomes useful when applied. Computing gives the same word a concrete everyday referent, a program that performs a task. Remember these as related meanings, without assuming that every English use of application transfers into Malay.

etymology.historical_story: Anderson developed as a patronymic surname: Ander or Anders, forms related to Andrew, combined with son. The Dictionary of American Family Names records Scottish and northern English origins alongside other routes, including Scandinavian names adapted in North America. Its historical family relationship does not determine the identity of a modern bearer. [Surname reference](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/anderson)

etymology.historical_story: Arnold belongs to an old Germanic naming tradition that combined meaningful elements. Its historical components refer to an eagle and power or rulership, creating an image of strength. Those components explain the name's ancestry; they are not productive Malay affixes, and the name does not mean an eagle in ordinary Malay conversation. [Dansk Navneleksikon](https://ordnet.dk/dnl/ordbog/Arnold)

etymology.historical_story: Anastasia is the feminine counterpart of Anastasius and belongs to a Greek naming tradition associated with resurrection. Its history includes Christian usage and transmission across several languages. That shared ancestry explains related spellings and different pronunciations; it does not make the name a Malay word meaning resurrection or identify any particular person's beliefs. [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/anastasia)

senses.ms_definition: Benda yang lazimnya mengandungi tulisan pada kertas, kain atau bahan lain, dipakai pada tubuh dan dipercayai mempunyai kesaktian untuk menolak penyakit, bencana atau bahaya.

etymology.historical_story: Traditional Malay descriptions of azimat often focus on writing made portable: inscriptions on paper, cloth, or other materials carried against the body. A small object could therefore embody a much larger hope of protection. This cultural history explains why the word belongs to discussions of belief and ritual, rather than ordinary jewellery. [DBP: azimat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=azimat).

etymology.historical_story: Apaan is formed from apa with the colloquial ending -an in Indonesian. Its dictionary treatment places it in conversational usage, where a question can convey a reaction rather than request information. This makes the word useful for recognizing informal Indonesian dialogue, but its shared root with Malay apa does not give it the same neutral status in Malaysian Malay.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先认出 apa＝什么，再把 apaan 听成带情绪的“什么呀？”；在马来西亚需要稳妥表达时，换回 apa 或 apakah。

senses.zh_definition: 用于存放或贴放照片、邮票等收藏品的册子；相册、集邮册等。

senses.zh_definition: 将若干歌曲或音乐作品编为一组发行的录音作品；音乐专辑。

etymology.historical_story: Album ultimately comes from Latin album, a white tablet or public noticeboard, related to albus, meaning white. European usage developed the idea into a book for collecting keepsakes, pictures, and signatures. Recorded music later extended the collection metaphor to groups of recordings. This history does not establish the immediate language through which Malay borrowed the word. See [Académie française: album](https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9A1084).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: album 的核心是“收成一册、一组”：照片收成相册，歌曲收成专辑。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为借入的独立词素记忆；ter 位于词内，不是马来语前缀 ter-，词尾 -if 也不在本词中分析为马来语派生词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 在特定条件下必须采取的选择或途径；尤其指仅存的可行办法。
senses.en_definition: A course of action that circumstances require, especially the only available option.
senses.ms_definition: Pilihan yang merupakan kemestian atau keharusan.
senses.nuances: 对应包内词典第一义。受限制或别无选择的意味通常由 satu-satunya、hanya 或 tiada 等上下文表达，并非每次出现 alternatif 都表示被迫。

senses.zh_definition: 可供选择的另一方案、办法或事物；替代选项。
senses.en_definition: An option that may be chosen instead of another.
senses.ms_definition: Satu pilihan antara dua kemungkinan.
senses.nuances: 所列马来释义保留《Kamus Dewan》的二选一表述；实际讨论也常以 beberapa alternatif 指多个备选方案。alternatif lain 在一般使用中自然，不能一概判为赘词。

senses.zh_definition: 可替代原有、常用或主要方案的；供另行选择的。
senses.en_definition: Available as a substitute for the usual or principal option.
senses.ms_definition: Yang boleh digunakan atau dipilih sebagai ganti kepada pilihan utama atau yang biasa.
senses.nuances: 这是 laluan alternatif、sumber alternatif 等名词后修饰用法的教学性归纳，未冒充包内词典新增的独立编号义项。表示有替代选择，不保证更优、更便宜或更安全。

etymology.historical_story: Alternatif belongs to the international word family represented by English alternative and French alternatif. The European history leads to Medieval Latin forms associated with taking turns. That image makes a useful bridge to choosing another course. In Malaysian public notices, the idea becomes concrete in laluan alternatif: another route when the main road is unavailable.

etymology.historical_story: English archer came through French forms associated with a bowman and ultimately with Latin arcus, meaning bow. Its history therefore centres on the weapon's curved shape. In a Malay conversation about a game, the same English label can identify a character class, while the established Malay word for the person is pemanah. [Oxford: archer](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/archer)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 archer 的开头与 arc（弧线）联系起来：弯成弧形的弓握在弓箭手手里；标准马来语记作 pemanah。

etymology.historical_story: Aiskrim adapts the English expression ice cream into a single Malay written word. Its spelling reflects the familiar borrowed forms ais and krim. The result is an ordinary Malay food name that works naturally with local flavour descriptions, allowing speakers to discuss durian, coconut, or chocolate varieties without switching the surrounding sentence into English.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把英语 ice cream 连起来听：ais + krim → aiskrim。脑中放一个冰凉的奶油球，读音和意思一起记。

senses.nuances: 可涵盖婚礼、亲属关系、社会礼仪及传统规范，不只指节庆活动；其具体内容随社群而异。释义参见 [DBP：adat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=syarak)。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合谈婚嫁、待客、节庆及传统规范。Adat 与宗教要求并非处处等同；不确定时可问“Ini adat keluarga atau tuntutan agama?”。不要轻率地用 tak tahu adat 指责他人。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 讨论别人的 adat 时，宜先询问当地或该家庭的做法，避免把一个族群、地区或家庭的习俗说成所有马来西亚人都必须遵守的规则。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合谈婚嫁、待客、节庆及传统规范。Adat 与宗教要求并非处处等同；不确定时可问“Ini adat keluarga atau tuntutan agama?”。不要轻率地用 tak tahu adat 指责他人。

etymology.historical_story: Adat is an Arabic loan associated with custom and habitual practice. In the Malay world, it became a name for locally inherited ways of organising social life. The borrowed word does not imply that those traditions originated in Arabia: an imported label can describe customs already rooted in a community. See [Viner's study of adat terminology](https://brill.com/view/journals/bki/137/1/article-p145_8.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 adat 联想到“按大家的传统办”：婚礼有 adat，做人要 tahu adat。这个联想用于记忆，不是词源解释。

morphology.pattern_note: -mu 是表示第二人称领属的附着代词，按后缀位置归类，与前词连写；词根不变，adik 的词尾 k 通常读作 [ʔ]。词头 Jawi 按词包保留 اديق，该形式仅对应 adik。

senses.nuances: adik 表示相对年龄，不限定男性；-mu 表示与你相联系的领属关系。需要明确性别时可说 adik lelakimu 或 adik perempuanmu。口语中也常说 adik awak 或 adik kau，选择取决于双方关系。adik 的基本释义见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274404&keyword=adik)；附着代词连写规则见 [DBP 拼写指南](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 询问对方弟妹时可自然使用，但不要仅凭 adik 推断性别。面向成年陌生人使用 adik 作称呼时，应考虑年龄、身份和对方是否接受这种亲近语气。

etymology.historical_story: Malay kinship vocabulary makes relative age especially visible: adik identifies a younger sibling without specifying gender. Adikmu combines that family term with the attached second-person pronoun -mu. Its meaning therefore comes from an ordinary grammatical combination, rather than a separate lexical origin. The same attachment pattern appears in rumahmu, meaning your house, and namamu, meaning your name. [DBP spelling guide](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 adik＝弟妹，再给词尾挂上 mu＝你的：adikmu 就是“你的弟妹”。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根以元音 a 起首；meN- 取 meng-，构成 mengansur，原有元音保留。ber- + ansur → beransur；ansur + -an → ansuran。

word_family.gloss: 逐渐变化；缓缓移动或离开

senses.zh_definition: 一点一点地；逐步地。
senses.en_definition: Gradually; little by little.
senses.ms_definition: Secara sedikit-sedikit, bukan sekali gus.

senses.zh_definition: 逐渐转变为某种状态。

senses.zh_definition: 缓缓移动、挪动，或逐渐离开某处。
senses.en_definition: To move slowly or leave a place gradually.
senses.ms_definition: Bergerak perlahan-lahan atau meninggalkan sesuatu tempat secara berperingkat.
senses.nuances: 移动义可见于 beransur 或 mengansur；离席时 Saya beransur dahulu 是较委婉的告辞表达。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: Saya beransur dahulu 可用于拜访或聚会后的委婉告辞；加上 Minta diri dahulu 更能明确表达礼貌离席。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: tolak ansur 是表示互相迁就或妥协的固定组合，不应把裸词 ansur 直接译成“宽容”。[DBP：bertolak ansur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=bertolak+ansur)

etymology.historical_story: Ansur links several familiar experiences through gradual movement: a person edges forward, a situation changes, and a debt is reduced payment by payment. Its derivatives preserve that shared image. The established expression tolak ansur adds the separate idea of mutual accommodation. These connections explain the word family without claiming an unsupported ancient source or a particular historical borrowing.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“慢慢挪”：身体慢慢挪是 beransur，状态慢慢变是 beransur pulih，欠款慢慢还便有 ansuran。

morphology.formula: ∅ + Abaddon → Abaddon（宗教专名，整词记忆）
morphology.pattern_note: 不能按马来语词缀拆分。IPA 采用常见英语读法，音节分写表示三音节识读，不代表已确立的马来语规范读音。未确认 DBP 普通词收录，故不标注 official；Jawi 保留 null。

senses.zh_definition: 亚巴顿：《启示录》9:11 中深渊天使的名字，其希腊语对应名为 Apollyon。
senses.en_definition: The name of the angel of the abyss in Revelation 9:11, corresponding to Greek Apollyon.
senses.ms_definition: Nama malaikat jurang maut yang disebut dalam Wahyu 9:11, dengan padanan nama Yunani Apollyon.
senses.nuances: 这是宗教文本中的专名，正常写作 Abaddon。不能不加说明地将其等同于 Satan；不同宗教解释与虚构作品也不应混同。马来语释义为文本内容的编写摘要，非 DBP 引文；搭配为文本用法示例。[《启示录》第9章](https://bible.usccb.org/bible/revelation/9)。

senses.zh_definition: 在希伯来圣经语境中指毁灭之地或阴间；可与死者世界并提。

etymology.historical_story: Abaddon carries a striking shift from a realm to a named figure. In Job, the term is associated with destruction and the world of the dead. Revelation uses it as the name of the angel of the abyss and pairs it with Apollyon. Readers therefore need the passage, not merely the spelling, to identify its reference. [Job](https://bible.usccb.org/bible/job/26), [Revelation](https://bible.usccb.org/bible/revelation/9).

etymology.historical_story: English has two historically distinct words spelled aye. The affirmative word is recorded from the sixteenth century, but its origin remains uncertain. The older word meaning always has Scandinavian ancestry. Their shared spelling can mislead learners, especially when an English–Malay dictionary lists both. Neither history establishes that an unidentified Malay corpus token has either meaning. See [Merriam-Webster word history](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/aye).

etymology.historical_story: Atmosfera belongs to an international scientific vocabulary built from Greek elements meaning vapour and sphere. The original image is a gaseous envelope around a world. Malay treats the resulting word as a complete scientific term. Its everyday educational setting is geography and weather, while the pressure-unit sense belongs especially to physics and chemistry. [Historical discussion](https://lexicon.mimesisjournals.com/archive/2018/spring/Atmosphere.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Abdul reflects Arabic naming grammar: ʿabd means servant, and the following al- belongs with the next name element. Muslim naming traditions brought such combinations into Malay personal names. A name such as Abdul Rahman expresses devotion through a divine name. In Malay, Abdul functions as a name element rather than a productive prefix. [Federal Territories Mufti Department](https://www.muftiwp.gov.my/ms/artikel/al-kafi-li-al-fatawi/1867-al-kafi-li-al-fatawi-siri-ke-437-hukum-menamakan-anak-dengan-al-faruq)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Abdul 想成姓名前半句“……的仆人”，后面的 Rahman 或 Rahim 才把意思补完整；它不表示“某人的儿子”。

etymology.historical_story: Atasinya is a grammatical combination rather than an independently borrowed word. Its immediate base is atasi, related to atas, meaning above or on top. The image of getting above a difficulty helps explain overcoming it, but serves here as a semantic illustration rather than a documented historical sequence. The attached -nya supplies the object. Reference: [DBP: mengatasi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?keyword=mengatasi).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: atas 是“上面”，atasi 想成“压过难题”，-nya 指“它”：atasinya＝把它解决掉。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词素记忆；词尾 /d/ 在部分马来西亚口音中可清化为不除阻的 [t̚]。

senses.zh_definition: 酸；一类能表现酸性、通常使蓝色石蕊试纸变红的化学物质，其水溶液在通常条件下的 pH 小于 7。
senses.en_definition: An acid: a substance whose aqueous solution typically has a pH below 7 and turns blue litmus red.
senses.ms_definition: Bahan yang mempunyai nilai pH kurang daripada 7, bersifat mengakis dan boleh menukarkan kertas litmus kepada warna merah.
senses.nuances: 是化学名词；表示“酸性的”通常用 berasid，表示食物“酸的”通常用 masam。腐蚀性取决于酸的种类和浓度，不能将所有含酸食物都理解为腐蚀性物质。马来文释义展开自所给 DBP 定义；pH 描述主要适用于水溶液。[DBP：asid](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=asid)

etymology.historical_story: The history of asid connects chemistry with an everyday sensation: sourness. Its ultimate source is Latin acidus, meaning sour. Malaysian science textbooks preserve this connection when introducing acids and alkalis. Familiar examples such as vinegar and citrus fruit help connect the scientific category with experiences learners already recognize. [Malaysian science textbook](https://bukuteksdigital.my/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/Sains_Tingkatan_2.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 a-sid 与英语 acid 连起来记：同一个“酸”概念；名词用 asid，形容“含酸的”用 berasid。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词，按三个音节发音，重音在首音节；ch 读 /k/。标准马来语对应词为 alkimia，不分析为马来语词根与词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 炼金术；结合物质实验与哲学思辨、尝试将普通金属转为黄金并寻求万能药或长生方法的古代传统。
senses.en_definition: An early experimental and philosophical tradition seeking metallic transmutation, universal remedies, or prolonged life.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris bagi alkimia, iaitu ilmu kimia pada peringkat awal perkembangannya.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词，不能因出现在马来语语料中就标为正式马来语。DBP 收录的对应词是 alkimia；本条 ms_definition 是释义说明。以下 ms 搭配采用马来语对应表达。[DBP：alkimia](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274404&keyword=alkimia)。

senses.nuances: 英语比喻义常用于艺术、烹饪或经济活动。马来语通常按语境译为 perubahan yang menakjubkan 等，不必机械套用 alkimia。[Merriam-Webster：alchemy](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/alchemy)。

etymology.historical_story: English alchemy travelled through French and medieval Latin from Arabic al-kīmiyāʾ, which ultimately connects with a Greek term of disputed origin. Arabic-to-Latin translations helped circulate alchemical learning in medieval Europe. The word later gained figurative uses for remarkable transformations, extending the image of turning ordinary materials into something precious. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/alchemy).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 ch 读 /k/：alchemy 与 chemistry 都让人想到物质变化；再把 alchemy 配上一幅“普通金属变黄金”的画面。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于家具选购、材料说明和植物介绍。翻译时先辨认树木、木材或英语灰烬义；不能把所有 ash 都译为 abu。

etymology.historical_story: English ash hides two separate histories behind one spelling. The tree name continues Old English æsc, while the word for the residue of burning comes from Old English æsce. Malay expressions such as pokok ash and kayu ash use the tree name. Remembering the two histories helps prevent a furniture description from being misunderstood as a reference to ashes. [Etymonline: ash](https://www.etymonline.com/word/ash).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先看搭配：pokok ash 是树，kayu ash 是木材；看到英语“灰烬”义时，另记马来语 abu。

morphology.pattern_note: -ku 是 aku 的附着形式，此处表示“我的”，须与前词连写；严格说是代词附着成分，并非派生后缀。ng 表示一个 /ŋ/ 音。输入包的 ابڠ 仅为词根写法，完整形式补上 کو。参见 [DBP：ku 的连写规则](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ku)。

senses.zh_definition: 我的哥哥；比我年长的男性手足。

senses.ms_definition: Saudara lelaki aku yang lebih tua daripada aku.

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 向长辈、客户或不熟悉的人介绍家人时，abang saya 通常更稳妥。abangku 带 aku 的亲近或文学色彩，并非通用敬语。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 对陌生男性可视场合称 abang，但不要直接套用 abangku，否则容易显得过分亲密。它也不表示“我的弟弟”，后者是 adik lelaki saya 或 adik lelakiku。

etymology.historical_story: Abangku combines a kinship term with the shortened first-person pronoun aku. Malay extends family words beyond literal relatives: abang can also address a husband or a slightly older man. Adding -ku makes the relationship explicitly personal. In poems, songs, and intimate letters, that compact ending can give an ordinary family reference a more affectionate or reflective voice.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: abang＝哥哥，-ku＝我的；把“归我这一边的亲人”接在词尾：abangku＝我哥哥。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入作为独立口语词条处理；它是 sahaja 的缩略形式，不是 a- 加 ja，也不是祈使或被动前缀。以下词族成员是对应变体，不是由 aja 加词缀派生。

word_family.gloss: 马来西亚常见口语写法：只、就、而已

senses.zh_definition: 只；仅；而已。限制前面所说的数量、对象或行为。
senses.en_definition: Only; just; no more than the stated amount, thing, or action.
senses.ms_definition: Sahaja atau hanya, untuk mengehadkan perkara atau jumlah yang disebut.
senses.nuances: 输入《Kamus Dewan》明确标注 bp，即 bahasa percakapan（口语），并释为 sahaja 的缩略。它在马来语中有记录，不应一概视为印尼语；但马来西亚不同群体也常用 saja 或 je。正式书面语用 sahaja。

senses.zh_definition: 老是；一直。表示某种行为或状态持续、反复出现。
senses.en_definition: Continually or repeatedly, often with an undertone of complaint.
senses.ms_definition: Sahaja, untuk menunjukkan perbuatan atau keadaan yang berterusan atau berulang.
senses.nuances: 常与 asyik 连用，中文可译为“老是……”。是否带责怪意味取决于语调和语境。这是 sahaja 相应用法在口语缩略形式中的体现。[DBP：sahaja](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=399108&keyword=sahaja)

etymology.historical_story: The supplied Kamus Dewan entry identifies aja as a conversational shortening of sahaja. Its history here is therefore one of everyday compression: a frequent grammatical word becomes shorter in familiar speech. Related forms such as saja help learners recognize the connection. Dictionary recognition records this conversational use; it does not make aja the preferred form for formal writing.

etymology.historical_story: Abe belongs to the living kinship vocabulary of Kelantan Malay. Research on East Coast family address records it as the local counterpart of abang. Its cultural interest lies in how a family relationship becomes an everyday way of addressing someone: the word can signal familiarity and local belonging as well as literal brotherhood. [Family-address study](https://plm.org.my/ejurnal/index.php/jurnallinguistik/article/download/3/1/)

etymology.historical_story: Alicia belongs to the international family of names associated with Alice. Its deeper ancestry leads through older European forms to a Germanic name associated with nobility. Different languages preserve different pronunciations, which explains why identical spellings need not sound alike. In a Malay conversation, it identifies a person rather than expressing an ordinary lexical meaning. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/alicia).

etymology.historical_story: Asteroid ultimately combines Greek elements meaning star and resembling. The name reflects appearance: through early telescopes, these objects looked like points of light rather than clearly resolved planetary discs. Malay uses the international scientific term as a whole word. Its history therefore links an observer's visual impression with the naming of a class of Solar System bodies. [Word history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/asteroid).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 aster 联想成“星”，把 -oid 理解为词源上的“像……的”：看起来像星点，实际是绕太阳运行的小天体。此拆分用于词源记忆，不是马来语构词分析。

etymology.historical_story: Akauntan is the Malay adaptation of English accountant. The English word has an older French history connected with accounting and rendering an account. The borrowing names a profession, while related Malay vocabulary distinguishes the account itself, akaun, from the field, perakaunan. This distinction helps learners connect financial records, professional activity, and the person responsible for them. [English word history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/accountant).

etymology.historical_story: English around continues Middle English forms combining a- and round. Its circular image remains visible in movement around a lake, while modern uses also express proximity and approximation. These are English developments; an occurrence inside a Malay conversation does not itself establish a standard Malay borrowing. [Source](https://scrabble.m-w.com/dictionary/around)

senses.zh_definition: 植物的根；通常向土中生长，具有固定植株、吸收水分和矿物质等功能的器官。

senses.ms_definition: Organ tumbuhan yang biasanya tumbuh di dalam tanah untuk mencengkam tanah serta menyerap air dan garam mineral.

senses.zh_definition: 根源；一个人、群体或文化的出身、源流及历史根基。

senses.ms_definition: Asal keturunan, asal usul atau dasar sejarah yang membentuk identiti seseorang atau sesuatu masyarakat.

senses.zh_definition: 问题、冲突或其他现象的深层根源；根本原因。

senses.ms_definition: Punca atau sebab asas yang menimbulkan sesuatu masalah atau keadaan.

senses.zh_definition: 词根；构成词族并承载核心词义的基本语素。

senses.nuances: 通常见于 akar kata 或 kata akar。须与 kata dasar 区别：构词所依附的 kata dasar 本身可以已经包含词缀，而词根是更基本的分析单位。参见 [DBP：词根与基本词的说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=akar+II%3B)。

senses.zh_definition: 数学中的根；某数经指定次方后得到给定数，或使某个方程成立的数值。
senses.en_definition: A mathematical root: a number yielding another under a specified power, or a value satisfying an equation.
senses.ms_definition: Nombor yang menghasilkan nombor tertentu apabila dikuasakan, atau nilai yang memenuhi sesuatu persamaan.
senses.nuances: 须区分求根号值与求方程的解：√9 的主平方根为 3，而 x² = 9 的根为 3 和 −3。输入提供的 DBP 条目已列出数的根这一义项。

senses.zh_definition: 某些攀缘植物或藤本植物名称中的组成部分；具体所指由完整植物名确定。
senses.en_definition: An element in the names of certain climbing plants or lianas.
senses.ms_definition: Unsur nama bagi beberapa jenis tumbuhan memanjat atau menjalar, dengan jenisnya ditentukan oleh nama penuh.
senses.nuances: 在这些植物名称中，akar 可指整株攀缘植物，不应一律译成其地下根部。另有罕见同形条目 akar III，DBP 仅交叉指向头衔中的 Agar II，不宜由此另造日常义项。参见 [DBP：akar 的同形条目](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=113780&keyword=akar)。

etymology.historical_story: Akar belongs to an inherited Austronesian family associated with reconstructed *wakaR, meaning root. Comparative records connect Malay akar with both roots and climbing plants. Its modern figurative meanings make an accessible conceptual bridge: as roots anchor a plant, ancestry anchors identity, and an underlying cause sustains a problem. This bridge explains meaning rather than dating each extension. [Comparative evidence](https://acd.clld.org/cognatesets/28726).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 akar 想成树根：植物靠根站稳，人有祖源，问题有根因，词有词根，数学也有根。

etymology.historical_story: Anne is a French form of Anna, belonging to the name family ultimately connected with Hebrew Hannah and the idea of favour or grace. Its history crosses languages rather than Malay affix patterns. In a Malay sentence, Anne identifies a person; its ancestral meaning does not become an ordinary Malay definition. [Anne](https://www.behindthename.com/name/anne-1), [Hannah](https://www.behindthename.com/name/hannah).

etymology.historical_story: Antik belongs to the international vocabulary associated with English antique and French antique, ultimately linked to Latin antiquus, meaning old. The precise route into Malay is not established here. Malay usage connects age with craftsmanship and collectability: an inherited cabinet may be admired for its keantikan, rather than dismissed as merely worn out. Compare [the history of antique](https://www.etymonline.com/word/antique).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 antik 和英语 antique 配对：想到老钟的“滴答”，就想到值得珍藏的古董；这只是联想，不是词源拆解。

etymology.historical_story: Alvin has several related Germanic naming histories. English forms are associated with older names including Ælfwine, Æðelwine and Ealdwine; Scandinavian usage also connects it with Alfvin. These histories do not make Alvin a Malay compound. In a Malay sentence, it identifies a person rather than expressing an ordinary dictionary meaning. See [Alvin's naming history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/alvin).

etymology.historical_story: Apalagi combines the familiar Malay words apa and lagi into a lexicalized connective. Kamus Dewan explains it through expressions meaning an even stronger case or an additional consideration. Its example moves from getting travel sick in a car to travelling by plane, illustrating a useful rhetorical pattern: if the lesser case already applies, consider the greater one. [DBP: apalagi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=apalagi)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: apa + lagi，联想“还有更进一步的”：连小事都办不到，apalagi 大事——“更不用说”。这是语义记忆法，不是逐字翻译。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，a- 不是马来语前缀。g 在本借词中读 /d͡ʒ/；e 为 é，对应 /e/，实际语音可接近 [ɛ]。音节为补充，DBP 标作 a.gén.da。词族列出常用组合，不把组合误作加缀派生词。

etymology.historical_story: Agenda ultimately comes from Latin agenda, 'things to be done', related to agere, 'to do'. Its origin explains why a meeting agenda points forward to unfinished business. Malay treats the borrowed form as an ordinary noun rather than applying Latin plural grammar. Modern usage also extends it to political priorities and concealed intentions. etymology.historical_story: Anjingnya has a grammatical history rather than a separate borrowing story: the established Malay noun anjing combines with the bound pronoun -nya. The resulting form identifies a dog through its owner, without specifying whether that owner is male or female. It demonstrates a productive pattern also found in rumahnya and bukunya, where an attached pronoun carries information English expresses with a separate possessive.

etymology.historical_story: Aras connects several familiar ways of describing position: water reaches a level, a building has floors, and a technical system has graded levels. These uses offer a coherent learning image of height or position. Dictionaries also preserve separate old chess and confection senses, but the available evidence does not establish one historical origin for every homonym.

etymology.historical_story: ATM compresses the English phrase Automated Teller Machine into three letters. A teller is a bank employee who handles customers' transactions; automation transfers some of that work to a machine. Malay keeps the international abbreviation while also using mesin teler automatik and mesin juruwang automatik, allowing the familiar letters to coexist with a descriptive Malay name. [DBP abbreviation entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=atm)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: A＝Automated，T＝Teller，M＝Machine：把银行柜员的部分工作交给机器，就是自动柜员机。

senses.zh_definition: 大约；左右；表示时间、数量等只是近似值。
senses.en_definition: Approximately; about, before an estimated quantity or duration.
senses.ms_definition: Lebih kurang atau kira-kira, untuk menyatakan jumlah atau tempoh yang tidak tepat.
senses.nuances: DBP 收录此副词用法。现代马来西亚语境中，kira-kira 或 lebih kurang 往往更自然；不要因此把所有 anggaran 都解释为名词“预算”。[DBP：anggaran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=anggaran+)

senses.nuances: DBP 标为 Id，即印度尼西亚用法。马来西亚组织章程通常用 perlembagaan、peraturan 或 undang-undang kecil，视文件性质而定。[DBP：anggar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=169476&keyword=anggar)

etymology.historical_story: Anggaran belongs to the anggar family of words for approximate calculation. The ending -an forms a noun naming the resulting estimate, while penganggaran names the process. Its recorded uses connect everyday reckoning with institutional finance: the same word can describe fuel needed for a journey or projected national revenue and expenditure. [DBP: anggar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=169476&keyword=anggar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 anggar 想成“先估一估”，-an 把动作变成结果：anggaran 就是估出来的数。

etymology.historical_story: DBP pairs Malay ambulan with English ambulant. The international medical term belongs to the Latin word family of ambulare, meaning to walk. Its history keeps the walking image central: an ambulant patient can move about rather than remain in bed. The precise borrowing route into Malay is not established by the supplied packet. See [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/ambulant).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ambulan 与“患者迈步走”连起来：它说的是能走动；救护车则是多一个 s 的 ambulans。

etymology.historical_story: English area comes from Latin area, a word associated with open ground, courtyards and threshing floors. Its spatial meaning later extended to measurement and fields of activity. In Malaysian mixed conversation, the English word can occupy the position of kawasan, while formal Malay chooses a translation suited to the context. [Sources: English etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/area), [PRPM translations](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=area).

etymology.historical_story: Alaric belongs to the Germanic naming tradition and is conventionally interpreted as 'ruler of all'. Its historical elements are associated with 'all' and 'ruler'; they are not Malay morphemes. The name is remembered through Visigothic history and later personal naming. In Malay writing, it functions as a borrowed proper name. See [the name's etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Alaric).

etymology.historical_story: Amanah comes from Arabic amānah, associated with trust and faithful guardianship. In Malaysian ethical discussion, holding office is described as receiving an amanah: authority brings an obligation to care for others' interests. This makes the word especially powerful when speaking about leadership, public money, and responsibility accepted on another person's behalf. [IKIM: Makna Amanah Kepimpinan](https://www.ikim.gov.my/makna-amanah-kepimpinan/)

etymology.historical_story: The base akhir is an Arabic loan meaning last or end, recorded as Arabic in historical Malay dictionaries. Malay combines this borrowed base with its own suffix -i to form akhiri. The word illustrates how an imported vocabulary item can enter a productive local grammatical system rather than remain an unchanged foreign expression. See [historical Malay dictionary: akhir](https://ms.wikisource.org/wiki/Laman%3AKitab_Loghat_Melayu.pdf/6).

etymology.historical_story: Augustus began as a Latin honorific associated with reverence and elevated status. The Roman Senate granted it to Octavian in 27 BCE, and it became the historical name by which Rome's first emperor is widely known. Later emperors also used the title, so an inscription containing Augustus need not refer to Octavian himself. See [British Museum: Augustus](https://www.britishmuseumshoponline.org/roman-emperors-postcard-pack.html).

etymology.historical_story: Ape illustrates how everyday writing can follow speech rather than standard spelling. Its final e represents the schwa heard in some Malay pronunciations of apa. A UiTM transcription glossary explicitly pairs Ape with Apa. The form therefore belongs to the relationship between spoken Malay and informal transcription, rather than representing a separate historical root. [UiTM glossary](https://ir.uitm.edu.my/64758/2/64758.pdf)

morphology.pattern_note: -kah 是附着式疑问语气词，不是改变词类的派生后缀；按本结构归入 suffix。awak 的 k 与 -kah 的 k 均保留，形成 kk；常见读音中 awak 的末尾 k 实现为喉塞音。资料包的 اوق 仅对应 awak，按要求保留；含 -kah 的完整形式可据构词写为 اوقکه。音节字段按资料包保留 null。

etymology.historical_story: Awak carries several established meanings in Malay, including body, self and the person being addressed. Awakkah adds the interrogative particle -kah to the personal pronoun. Its meaning is therefore compositional, rather than the result of a separate borrowing: the question singles out you as the possible person concerned. [DBP: awak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=awak), [DBP: -kah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=kah)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: awak 是“你”，-kah 挂上问号：awak + kah →“是你吗？”

etymology.historical_story: Audio belongs to an international vocabulary of sound technology. Its historical basis is Latin audire, meaning to hear, through the combining form audio-. Malay uses the complete word for sound-related media and equipment. The connection helps link ordinary listening with modern recordings, without treating the Latin material as productive Malay affixes. Sources: [American Heritage](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=AUDIO-) and [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=audio).

etymology.historical_story: Anatoly is a Roman-letter rendering of the Russian masculine name Анатолий. Its naming history leads back to Greek Anatolios and anatolē, associated with sunrise or the east. In Malay writing, it functions as a person's name. Its historical meaning explains the name's origin; it does not make Anatoly a Malay word meaning sunrise. [姓名词源依据](https://www.behindthename.com/name/anatoliy)

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 引用法律时写清正式名称及相关条文；跨马来西亚与印度尼西亚语境翻译时，先判断 akta 指法令还是证明文书。

etymology.historical_story: Akta belongs to an international legal vocabulary associated with Latin actus and related European forms. Malay language educational material identifies its Latin ancestry, but does not establish every stage of transmission. Its meanings preserve the link between authoritative writing and public institutions: in Malaysian usage, the parliamentary statute is the central sense. See [Sekata](https://www.languagecouncils.sg/mbms/en/-/media/mlc/documents/pdfs/sekata/sekata-master-e-version---24-august-2018.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用英语 Act 帮记 akta：两者都可指法令；这是意义联想，不是现代马来语的词缀拆分。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在这里是附着于名词的后接代词或回指成分，归入本结构的 suffix 类；ny 读单一辅音 /ɲ/，不是 /nj/，h 保留。词包的 اره 仅对应 arah；完整 arahnya 可写作 ارهڽ。词包未提供音节，故保留 null；教学分音为 a.rah.nya。

word_family.gloss: 有明确方向的；朝向某处的

senses.zh_definition: 其方向；他或她所朝向、行进或面对的方向；上下文已提及的那个方向。
senses.en_definition: His, her, or its direction; the direction already identified in context.
senses.ms_definition: Hala atau jurusan yang dikaitkan dengan seseorang atau sesuatu yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: 这是 arah 加 -nya 的语法形式，并非与 arah 完全独立的词。-nya 的具体所指须由上下文确定，不必机械译成“他的”。arahnya 本身不是“命令他”；命令义通常见于 arahkan、mengarahkan 或 arahan。[DBP: arah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=arah)。

senses.zh_definition: 其目标、意图或发展方向；某项讨论、行动或事业的趋向。
senses.en_definition: Its aim, purpose, or course of development.
senses.ms_definition: Tujuan, maksud atau haluan perkembangan sesuatu perkara yang dirujuk.
senses.nuances: 用于抽象事务时，arah 指目标或走向。没有上下文的 arahnya 不等于“趋势”；“趋势”通常表达为 arah aliran。此义承接 arah 的“目的、意图”义。[DBP: arah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=arah)。

collocations.zh: 没有明确方向；漫无目的

spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式。
tak 是 tidak 的口语形式。
arahnya 回指双方正在寻找的路线方向，标准释句将所指说清楚。
回复中的 je 和 kat 分别对应 sahaja 和地点介词 di。

messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah tengok peta, tapi masih tak pasti arahnya.
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah melihat peta, tetapi masih tidak pasti tentang arah yang perlu dituju.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: arahnya 本身没有敬语或贬义。向陌生人问路时，可说 Maaf, boleh tunjukkan arah ke stesen?，先致意并说明目的地。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 只有在所指清楚时才使用 -nya。正式报告中若同时提到多个计划、人员或地点，宜重述具体名称，避免 arahnya 产生歧义。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: arahnya 本身没有敬语或贬义。向陌生人问路时，可说 Maaf, boleh tunjukkan arah ke stesen?，先致意并说明目的地。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 只有在所指清楚时才使用 -nya。正式报告中若同时提到多个计划、人员或地点，宜重述具体名称，避免 arahnya 产生歧义。

etymology.historical_story: Arahnya illustrates a productive Malay grammatical pattern rather than a separate borrowing: arah combines with attached -nya to identify a contextually understood direction or purpose. Malay spelling joins this element to the preceding word. Consequently, a short form can carry information that English often expresses through a possessive determiner or a longer phrase. See [DBP spelling guidelines](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: arah 是“方向”，-nya 像接在后面的指针：指回他、她或前文那件事的方向。

morphology.pattern_note: -an 构成名词，表示所教导的内容；词根拼写不变。接后缀后按 a.ja.ran 划分音节，r 成为末音节的声母。

senses.zh_definition: 教导；传授给人的知识、劝诫、行为准则或宗教教义。
senses.en_definition: Teaching or teachings; instruction, advice, or principles imparted to others.
senses.ms_definition: Perkara yang diajarkan kepada seseorang, termasuk nasihat, panduan dan tuntunan agama.
senses.nuances: 强调所传授的内容。pengajaran 还可指教学活动或从经历中得到的教训，因此不能在所有语境下互换。表示遵循教义常说 berpegang pada ajaran。[DBP：ajaran 与 pengajaran](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?d=10&k=ajaran)

senses.zh_definition: 学说；由某位思想家、学者或某一学派提出的理论与思想体系。
senses.en_definition: A doctrine, theory, or school of thought associated with a thinker or tradition.
senses.ms_definition: Teori, fahaman atau mazhab yang dikemukakan oleh seseorang tokoh atau sesuatu aliran pemikiran.
senses.nuances: 常用于思想史、哲学及宗教学讨论；在科学技术语境中，明确指某项理论时通常以 teori 更精确。ajaran 不只用于宗教。

senses.zh_definition: 为使人改正错误而施加的惩戒或惩罚性教训。
senses.en_definition: Punishment or chastisement intended to correct misconduct.
senses.ms_definition: Hukuman atau tindakan menghukum yang bertujuan menyedarkan seseorang supaya tidak mengulangi kesalahan.
senses.nuances: 这是输入词典所列的惩戒义，现代一般表达中较少单独使用。beri dia ajaran 在冲突语境中可能带有威吓意味；普通的经验教训通常用 pengajaran。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Forum itu membincangkan peranan ajaran agama dalam memupuk sikap saling menghormati dalam masyarakat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该论坛讨论了宗教教义在培养社会成员相互尊重方面的作用。
dual_scenarios.en: The forum discussed the role of religious teachings in fostering mutual respect in society.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku masih ingat ajaran cikgu dulu: kalau tak faham, tanya je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya masih ingat akan ajaran guru dahulu: jika tidak faham, tanyalah.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我还记得以前老师的教导：不懂就问。
dual_scenarios.en: I still remember what our teacher taught us: if you don't understand, just ask.
spoken_features: aku 用于熟人之间。
tak 对应 tidak。
je 对应 sahaja，此处使建议显得轻松。
cikgu 是日常常用的教师称谓。

messages.speaker: Farah (老同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau ingat lagi tak ajaran cikgu dulu pasal tolong orang?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu masih ingat akan ajaran guru dahulu tentang membantu orang lain?
messages.zh: 你还记得以前老师关于帮助别人的教导吗？
messages.en: Do you still remember what our teacher taught us about helping others?

messages.speaker: Amir (老同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Ingatlah. Kalau mampu, tolong je, tak payah tunggu orang minta.
messages.ms_standard: Saya masih ingat. Jika mampu, bantulah tanpa menunggu orang meminta bantuan.
messages.zh: 当然记得。帮得上就帮，不用等人家开口。
messages.en: Of course. If you can help, just do it. Don't wait for someone to ask.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈及他人的宗教或思想传统时可用 ajaran，搭配具体名称能避免含糊。ajaran sesat 是强烈的宗教评价，不宜随意用于与自己意见不同的人。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 宗教讨论应准确说明所指教义及评价来源。人际冲突中避免以 nak bagi ajaran 等说法表达不满，因为对方可能理解为威胁惩罚或动手。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 谈及他人的宗教或思想传统时可用 ajaran，搭配具体名称能避免含糊。ajaran sesat 是强烈的宗教评价，不宜随意用于与自己意见不同的人。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 宗教讨论应准确说明所指教义及评价来源。人际冲突中避免以 nak bagi ajaran 等说法表达不满，因为对方可能理解为威胁惩罚或动手。

etymology.historical_story: Ajaran combines the established root ajar with the Malay noun-forming suffix -an. Historical scholarship connects ajar with Sanskrit ācārya, meaning a teacher, within the wider history of South Asian lexical influence. The modern formation shifts attention from teaching as an activity to the advice, principles, or doctrine that someone passes on. [Historical linguistic study](https://brill.com/display/book/9789004529458/9789004529458_webready_content_text.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ajar 是“教”，加 -an，把“教”装成一份内容：ajaran，就是教下来的道理。

morphology.pattern_note: au 为同一音节内的双元音。表示汽车时是独立借词；表示自动时是 automatik 的缩略形式。两者均不宜拆成马来语词根与词缀。

word_family.gloss: 旧式复合词：货车；不是加缀派生词

senses.zh_definition: 汽车；小汽车。属于带有印尼语及荷兰语背景的旧式用词。
senses.en_definition: A motorcar; an older word associated with Indonesian usage of Dutch origin.
senses.ms_definition: Kereta; motokar.
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Dewan》标为 IB。现代马来西亚一般使用 kereta 或 motokar；auto gerobak 是词典记录的旧式货车名称，不宜当作现代常用搭配。[DBP：auto](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=auto)

collocations.en: to travel in a motorcar, in older usage

senses.zh_definition: 自动的；能够按设定自行运作的，是 automatik 的缩略形式。
senses.en_definition: Automatic; operating without continual manual control, shortened from automatik.
senses.ms_definition: Kependekan bagi automatik.
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Pelajar》收录此缩略义。常见于设备模式、相机设置和汽车变速器说明；正式技术行文通常写完整形式 automatik。此义与旧式的“汽车”义须按语境区分。[DBP：auto](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=auto)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Juruteknik mengesahkan bahawa mod auto pada mesin itu berfungsi dengan baik.
dual_scenarios.zh: 技术人员确认，该机器的自动模式运作正常。
dual_scenarios.en: The technician confirmed that the machine's automatic mode was working properly.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Letak kamera kat mod auto je, senang sikit.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Tetapkan kamera kepada mod automatik supaya lebih mudah digunakan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 相机调成自动模式就好，比较省事。
dual_scenarios.en: Just put the camera on auto. It's easier.
spoken_features: kat 在这里代替表示设置位置的标准介词结构。
je 是 sahaja 的口语缩略形式。
senang sikit 是比较随意的“更方便一点”。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak ambil gambar ni. Guna mod auto je boleh?
messages.ms_standard: Saya mahu mengambil gambar ini. Bolehkah saya menggunakan mod automatik sahaja?
messages.zh: 我想拍这张照片，用自动模式就行吗？
messages.en: I want to take this photo. Can I just use auto mode?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Boleh je. Kamera tu dah pilih tetapan yang sesuai.
messages.ms_standard: Boleh. Kamera itu sudah memilih tetapan yang sesuai.
messages.zh: 可以啊，相机已经选好合适的设置了。
messages.en: Sure. The camera has already picked suitable settings.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 本词本身没有敬称或冒犯色彩。向客户或长辈解释设备时，可先说 mod automatik，再指出屏幕上的 auto 标签。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 现代马来西亚谈普通汽车通常说 kereta；谈自动挡时说 kereta auto 很自然。正式采购规格宜写 kereta bertransmisi automatik，以免语义含糊。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 本词本身没有敬称或冒犯色彩。向客户或长辈解释设备时，可先说 mod automatik，再指出屏幕上的 auto 标签。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 现代马来西亚谈普通汽车通常说 kereta；谈自动挡时说 kereta auto 很自然。正式采购规格宜写 kereta bertransmisi automatik，以免语义含糊。

etymology.historical_story: Auto preserves two distinct lexical histories. DBP marks its motorcar sense IB, linking it with Indonesian usage of Dutch origin; Dutch also uses auto for a car. Separately, DBP records auto as a shortening of automatik. This explains why an older passage may use the word for a vehicle while a modern camera menu uses it for a setting. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=auto), [Cambridge Dutch–English](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/dutch-english/auto)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 auto，先看场景：旧文里想到“汽车”，按钮上想到“自动”。au 连读，分节为 au.to。

morphology.pattern_note: 韩语称谓的整词转写，没有可分析的马来语词缀。所列 IPA 仅为按 ajussi 拼写给出的马来语近似读法，并非已核实的规范音；韩语 아저씨 通常读作 [a.dʑʌ.ɕ͈i]，规范罗马字为 ajeossi。

senses.zh_definition: 韩语称谓，指称或称呼成年男子，常对应“大叔”或“先生”；马来语交流中主要见于韩剧及韩国文化语境。
senses.en_definition: A Korean term used to refer to or address an adult man, often a middle-aged man; mister or uncle.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam konteks bahasa dan budaya Korea, panggilan atau sebutan bagi lelaki dewasa, lazimnya lelaki pertengahan umur.
senses.nuances: 这是依据韩语原词编写的马来语释义，并非 DBP 官方释义；输入没有提供 DBP 收录证据，因此本条 status 的指定值不应被解读为 DBP 已认可该拼写。韩语原词另有指父母同辈男性亲属的用法，但不能直接推定为马来语中的独立通行义。它不专指帅气、富有或具有浪漫吸引力的年长男子。[韩国国立国语院词典](https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=26237&nation=eng)

dual_scenarios.context: 文化报道 / 韩语称谓介绍
dual_scenarios.ms: Penceramah menerangkan bahawa ajussi ialah panggilan bahasa Korea untuk lelaki dewasa dan penggunaannya bergantung pada konteks sosial.
dual_scenarios.zh: 讲者解释说，ajussi 是韩语中对成年男子的称呼，其使用取决于社交情境。
dual_scenarios.en: The speaker explained that ajussi is a Korean term of address for an adult man and that its use depends on the social context.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友讨论韩剧称谓
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kenapa dia panggil lelaki tu ajussi? Dia nampak muda je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Mengapakah dia memanggil lelaki itu ajussi? Lelaki itu kelihatan muda sahaja.
dual_scenarios.zh: 她干吗叫那男的大叔啊？他看着挺年轻的呀。
dual_scenarios.en: Why does she call that guy ajussi? He looks pretty young.
spoken_features: kenapa 对应 mengapa
tu 对应 itu
panggil 在口语中省略主动前缀
je 对应 sahaja，表达随意的判断
韩语称谓嵌入马来语句子，体现文化语境中的语码混用

messages.speaker: Aina (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kenapa dia panggil lelaki tu ajussi? Dia nampak muda je.
messages.ms_standard: Mengapakah dia memanggil lelaki itu ajussi? Lelaki itu kelihatan muda sahaja.
messages.zh: 她干吗叫那男的大叔啊？他看着挺年轻的呀。
messages.en: Why does she call that guy ajussi? He looks pretty young.

messages.speaker: Mei (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dia nak usik je kot. Tengoklah, lelaki tu dah merajuk!
messages.ms_standard: Mungkin dia hanya hendak mengusiknya. Lihatlah, lelaki itu sudah merajuk!
messages.zh: 可能就是想逗逗他吧。你看，那男的已经闹别扭了！
messages.en: Maybe she's just teasing him. Look, he's sulking already!

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 在马来西亚与陌生人交流时，优先按场合使用 encik 等称呼。ajussi 适用于讨论韩语或双方理解的玩笑；直接这样称呼别人可能让对方觉得自己被说老。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 韩语原词并非天然的贬称，也不是适用于所有对象的敬称；称呼是否得体取决于关系、年龄感受与场景。不要用它替代已知的职业或正式职衔。[韩国国立国语院说明](https://www.korean.go.kr/front/onlineQna/onlineQnaView.do?mn_id=216&qna_seq=311909)

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 在马来西亚与陌生人交流时，优先按场合使用 encik 等称呼。ajussi 适用于讨论韩语或双方理解的玩笑；直接这样称呼别人可能让对方觉得自己被说老。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 韩语原词并非天然的贬称，也不是适用于所有对象的敬称；称呼是否得体取决于关系、年龄感受与场景。不要用它替代已知的职业或正式职衔。[韩国国立国语院说明](https://www.korean.go.kr/front/onlineQna/onlineQnaView.do?mn_id=216&qna_seq=311909)

etymology.historical_story: Ajussi represents Korean 아저씨, conventionally romanized ajeossi. The National Institute of Korean Language records both a kinship use for men in one's parents' generation and an everyday address for unrelated adult men. The spelling ajussi reflects a popular alternative transcription. Its appearance in Malay discussions of Korean culture does not by itself establish official Malay dictionary recognition. [Korean dictionary](https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=26237&nation=eng)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象韩剧里喊一声“阿啾西”：想到对成年男子的“大叔”称呼即可；不要把它记成“帅大叔”的专称。

morphology.pattern_note: 词尾 ng 表示单一鼻音 /ŋ/。派生时 meN- 在元音前采用 meng-：meN- + ambang → mengambang。DBP 区分 ambang I 与 ambang II，不能把所有派生义视为同一义项。

word_family.gloss: ambang I 的派生义：阻挡；拦住
ambang II 的派生义：漂浮；悬浮

senses.zh_definition: 横设于门、窗上方或两根柱子之间的木梁、横档。
senses.en_definition: A lintel or crosspiece above an opening or between posts.
senses.ms_definition: Kayu atau balak yang melintang di atas pintu atau jendela, atau di antara tiang.
senses.nuances: ambang I 的实体义。这里首先指上方横梁，不能在所有建筑语境中都译为脚下的门槛。释义依据：[DBP: ambang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=ambang)。

senses.zh_definition: 门口或出入口的交界处；特定建筑术语中也指门槛。
senses.en_definition: A doorway or entrance threshold; technically, a door sill.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian muka pintu atau tempat peralihan pada pintu masuk; dalam istilah binaan, ambang bawah pintu.
senses.nuances: di ambang pintu 常表示“在门口”。具体构件须看上下文；DBP 建筑术语也将 door sill 对译为 ambang pintu。[DBP 建筑术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=ambang)。

senses.zh_definition: 某事件发生或进入某阶段之前的临近时刻；前夕、关口。
senses.en_definition: The eve, brink, or threshold of an event or stage.
senses.ms_definition: Waktu atau peringkat yang hampir mendahului sesuatu peristiwa atau perubahan.
senses.nuances: 常用结构为 di ambang + 事件或阶段；既可用于庆典，也可用于危机。空间门口与时间关口的联系适合作语义记忆，不等于已经证实的词源演变。

senses.zh_definition: 某种反应、感知或变化开始出现所需达到的临界水平；阈值。
senses.en_definition: A threshold level at which a response or change begins.
senses.ms_definition: Aras atau nilai batas yang perlu dicapai untuk mencetuskan sesuatu tindak balas atau perubahan.
senses.nuances: 用于科学和技术语境；不同领域必须说明测量对象及单位。不能把所有阈值都解释为最大容许值。[DBP 科学术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=ambang)。

senses.zh_definition: 漂浮、悬浮或悬荡；此义通常通过 mengambang、terambang 等派生形式使用。
senses.en_definition: To float or hover, normally expressed in derived forms.
senses.ms_definition: Mengapung atau terkatung-katung, khususnya dalam bentuk mengambang atau terambang.
senses.nuances: 对应独立同形词 ambang II；不是把名词“门楣”直接当作常用裸动词。下列搭配保留实际使用的派生形式。[DBP: mengambang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mengambang)。

etymology.historical_story: DBP records ambang as both a doorway crosspiece and the moment just before an event. For learners, standing at an entrance offers a useful image for approaching a new stage. This is a semantic illustration, not a documented origin story. DBP separately distinguishes the floating root ambang II. [DBP: ambang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=ambang).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: am-bang，想象门上的横梁“砰”地提醒你：到了门口，也就到了新阶段的关口。

morphology.formula: ∅ + american → american（按马来语分析作为外语整词处理）
morphology.pattern_note: 资料包的根词标记仅用于本条马来语分析。英语内部可分析为 America + -an → American，但 -an 在此不是马来语后缀。英语规范拼写为 American，首字母大写；IPA 为英语读音。

senses.zh_definition: 美国人；在明确的泛美地理语境中，也可指美洲居民。
senses.en_definition: A person from the United States; in a broader geographical context, a person from the Americas.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, orang Amerika Syarikat; dalam konteks geografi yang lebih luas, penduduk benua Amerika.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词义的马来语释义，不是马来语词条的官方定义。马来语通常用 orang Amerika 或更明确的 warga Amerika Syarikat。美国义与泛美义须按语境区分。参见 [Cambridge 的 American 词条](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/american?topic=nationalities)及 [DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=162656&keyword=American)。以下为英语搭配。

senses.nuances: 马来语一般以 Amerika 或 Amerika Syarikat 作后置修饰语，如 budaya Amerika。American 保留在英文名称或英语引用中。参见 [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/american?topic=nationalities)。以下搭配属于英语。

senses.nuances: 地理义范围大于“美国的”，常由 North、South 或 continental 等上下文明确。参见 [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/american?topic=nationalities)。以下为英语搭配。

etymology.historical_story: The geographical name America was placed on Martin Waldseemüller’s 1507 map in honour of Amerigo Vespucci, using a Latinized form of his name. American later identifies people or things associated with that geography. Its present meanings distinguish the United States from the wider Americas, while standard Malay normally uses Amerika or Amerika Syarikat. [Library of Congress](https://blogs.loc.gov/loc/2016/07/how-did-america-get-its-name/), [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/american?topic=nationalities).

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入包将 apatah 作为独立词条处理；内部可分析为 apa 加疑问强调附着成分 -tah。-tah 连写，不引起词干音变；它不是普通派生后缀。

word_family.gloss: 究竟什么；有什么呢，依语境而定

senses.zh_definition: 用来强调程度更深或更不可能的情况，通常构成 apatah lagi，意为“更何况；更不用说”。
senses.en_definition: An emphatic expression, usually in apatah lagi, meaning much more so or, after a negative statement, let alone.
senses.ms_definition: Lebih-lebih lagi; apalagi.
senses.nuances: 核心是递进推论。前句为否定时，常译为“连……都不……，更不用说……”；前句为肯定时，可译为“更何况”。不能一律翻译成 what else。此处 particle 为给定词性集合下的功能性标注。[DBP：apatah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=apatah)

collocations.en: all the more so; let alone
especially if; all the more so if

senses.zh_definition: 用于自问或反问，强调“究竟有什么；又有什么”，常带感叹、无奈或质疑语气。
senses.en_definition: An emphatic rhetorical question form meaning what or what possible, often expressing doubt or resignation.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk apa yang disertai partikel -tah untuk mengungkapkan pertanyaan kepada diri sendiri atau pertanyaan retorik.
senses.nuances: 主要见于文学或较庄重表达，如 apatah gunanya。完整结构含疑问成分 apa；此处 particle 是受限词性集合下的近似标注。马来语正字法规定 -tah 与前词连写。[DBP：马来语拼写指南](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Apatah combines apa, meaning “what”, with the attached particle -tah. Malay spelling guidance requires this particle to join the preceding word. The form supports rhetorical questioning, while the dictionary records its emphatic meaning alongside apalagi. For learners, apatah lagi provides a useful bridge between rhetorical emphasis and everyday expressions of comparison.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 lagi“还、更”：前面已如此，apatah lagi 后面就“更何况／更不用说”。

etymology.historical_story: Audrey developed from earlier forms of Etheldreda, connected with an Old English personal name whose elements mean noble and strength. Saint Etheldreda, associated with Ely, helped preserve the name in cultural memory. This is the history of an English personal name, not a Malay derivational formula or a description of everyone bearing it. See [Audrey: etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Audrey).

senses.ms_definition: Sesungut beruas pada kepala serangga dan haiwan tertentu yang berfungsi sebagai organ deria.
senses.nuances: 属于生物学用语，日常解释常用 sesungut。马来语不套用英语或拉丁语复数 antennae；一对触角可说 sepasang antena。[DBP《Kamus Pelajar》释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=antena)

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 本词语气中性，可用于课堂、技术说明和日常交谈。向技术人员描述问题时，说 antena tidak menerima isyarat dengan baik 比笼统说 antena rosak 更具体。

etymology.historical_story: Antena belongs to an international word family tracing back to Latin antenna, a sail yard. The projecting shape also supplied a name for animal feelers. Radio engineering later adopted the term for transmitting and receiving structures. Malay records both the technological and biological meanings, linking two kinds of reception in one word. [Historical account](https://ethw.org/w/images/a/a8/IEEE_Vehicular_Technology_Society_Newsletter_-_47%283%29August_2000.pdf), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=antena)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 an-te-na 和英语 antenna 一起记：屋顶天线接收电波，昆虫触角接收环境信息。

morphology.pattern_note: 科学借词，按整词处理；开头的 ad- 和结尾的 -in 不是这里的马来语生产性词缀。所列读音为依马来语拼读习惯给出的宽式读音。

senses.zh_definition: 肾上腺素；主要由肾上腺髓质分泌、帮助身体应对紧张或危险的激素，也称 epinefrina。
senses.en_definition: Adrenaline, or epinephrine: a hormone secreted chiefly by the adrenal medulla that helps prepare the body to respond to stress or danger.
senses.ms_definition: Hormon daripada medula kelenjar adrenal yang membantu menyediakan tubuh untuk menghadapi tekanan atau bahaya; juga dikenali sebagai adrenalina atau epinefrina.
senses.nuances: DBP 的规范生物学词条采用 adrenalina，并曾明确建议以此拼写对应 adrenalin；因此，不能把本条保留的输入形式视为首选规范术语。日常说 adrenalin naik，常借指紧张或兴奋时的身体反应。参见 [DBP 规范拼写说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=adrenal)及 [adrenalina 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=95408&keyword=adrenalina)。

dual_scenarios.en: In this report, adrenalin is termed adrenalina in accordance with DBP's biological terminology.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 属于中性科学词。朋友之间可以用它形容兴奋或紧张；正式马来语科普及专业写作宜优先使用 adrenalina。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合运动、惊险经历和生理反应的讨论。谈论实际医疗记录时，应沿用记录中的准确药物名称，避免把日常所说的兴奋感直接当作医学判断。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 属于中性科学词。朋友之间可以用它形容兴奋或紧张；正式马来语科普及专业写作宜优先使用 adrenalina。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合运动、惊险经历和生理反应的讨论。谈论实际医疗记录时，应沿用记录中的准确药物名称，避免把日常所说的兴奋感直接当作医学判断。

etymology.historical_story: Adrenalin entered international scientific vocabulary through research on extracts of the adrenal glands. Takamine used Adrenalin as a name for the active substance, and an early surgical paper already described its practical applications in 1903. Malay subsequently adopted related terminology, with DBP selecting adrenalina as its biological headword. [Early surgical account](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5150929/); [DBP terminology](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=95408&keyword=adrenalina)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 连着记：adrenal 是肾上腺相关，adrenalin 是肾上腺素；想象比赛发令前，身体突然进入警戒状态。

morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语中作为完整人名处理，不分析为 al- 加马来语词根。资料包未提供本人读音或爪夷文写法；aa 不能直接证明马来语中存在长元音。

senses.zh_definition: 阿尔塔夫：人名，见于穆斯林命名传统；本资料包未确定具体所指。
senses.en_definition: Altaaf, a personal name used in Muslim naming traditions; the particular referent is unspecified.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang yang digunakan dalam tradisi penamaan Muslim; individu yang dimaksudkan tidak dikenal pasti dalam bahan yang diberikan.
senses.nuances: 此处按人名处理，不能直接解释成马来语普通名词“恩惠”。[Jamiat-Ul-Ulama of Mauritius 的姓名资料](https://www.jamiat-ul-ulama.org/node/1425)将 Altaaf 联系到阿拉伯语表示恩惠、善意的复数形式。该来源不能证明它已经成为马来语普通词，也不能确定资料包中的具体人物。以下搭配和例句为教学示例，不是已核实的高频搭配。status 沿用用户指定的数据标签，不表示 DBP 认证；frequency_rank 来自资料包。

etymology.historical_story: Altaaf is documented in Muslim naming guidance as a name associated with an Arabic plural expressing kindnesses, graces, or favours. This background explains a naming association rather than a Malay dictionary meaning. In Malay communication, the name identifies its bearer, while the bearer's own spelling and pronunciation remain the appropriate reference. [Source](https://www.jamiat-ul-ulama.org/node/1425)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Altaaf 与一位名字寓有“善意、恩惠”的朋友联系起来；这是姓名背景提示，不是把 Altaaf 当作马来语“善良”的替换词。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -an 构成名词；词根末尾的 l 在连续发音中成为下一音节的声母，因此读作 a.ma.lan。部分读法保留词首阿拉伯语来源的 /ʕ/。

word_family.gloss: 实行；养成并保持某种习惯

senses.zh_definition: 经常实行的做法、习惯或惯例；也指某个领域日常采用的实践方式。
senses.en_definition: A habitual practice, custom, or established way of doing something.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang dilakukan, dilaksanakan atau dikerjakan sebagai suatu kebiasaan.
senses.nuances: 本义不保证做法良好，也可说 amalan buruk 或 amalan rasuah。pada amalannya 表示“在实际操作中”。马来语定义将 DBP 原文缩写展开，参见 [DBP：amalan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=amalan)。

senses.zh_definition: 善行；对他人或社会有益的行为。
senses.en_definition: A good or charitable deed.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan baik; kebajikan.
senses.nuances: 这一义项突出行为的道德价值，不要求行为已经形成习惯。宗教语境中的 amalan 常指实际履行的善行或修持，具体范围取决于上下文。参见 [DBP：amalan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=amalan)。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合生活、职业、公益及宗教语境。描述跨宗教活动时可明确写 amalan keagamaan，并具体说明所属传统，避免把所有实践理解为同一种宗教仪式。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 谈论健康或工作习惯时语气中性；评价他人的宗教 amalan 时应尊重个人隐私，避免以自己的实践标准评判对方。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合生活、职业、公益及宗教语境。描述跨宗教活动时可明确写 amalan keagamaan，并具体说明所属传统，避免把所有实践理解为同一种宗教仪式。

etymology.historical_story: Amalan combines amal, an Arabic-derived word associated with deeds and action, with the Malay suffix -an. Its meanings connect two everyday concerns: what people repeatedly do and what good they accomplish. Consequently, the same word appears in discussions of eating habits, workplace routines and charitable conduct, with context determining whether regularity or moral value is central. [DBP: amal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=amal).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: amal 是“做的事”，加 -an 成 amalan：经常做，就是“习惯”；做有益的事，就是“善行”。

morphology.formula: ah + 表情性重复字母 h → ahhh（非词缀构词）
morphology.pattern_note: 依资料包保留独立检索词形 ahhh；其规范对应形式是 ah。重复 h 表示声音延长或情绪加强，不增加音节，也不是后缀。[aːh] 仅为示意读音，实际时长、声调及是否发出末尾气声随语境变化。

word_family.gloss: 啊——；聊天中表示声音延长

senses.zh_definition: 啊、哼；表示不赞同、拒绝、不耐烦或不相信，具体态度由语调和后文决定。
senses.en_definition: An expressive exclamation conveying disagreement, rejection, irritation or disbelief.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan tidak baku bagi kata seru ah yang dipanjangkan untuk menyatakan bantahan, penolakan atau rasa tidak senang.
senses.nuances: 实际词类为 kata seru；本结构用 particle 容纳感叹词。ahhh 是非规范的聊天拼写；status 的 official 仅按题设固定标签保留，不代表该拼写获 DBP 规范认可。DBP 确认 ah 属于感叹词，并示范其不赞同用法，见 [PRPM：kata seru 的用法](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=seru)。下列组合是话语接续，不是固定词组。

senses.zh_definition: 啊——；在聊天中表示松了一口气、舒适或满足。
senses.en_definition: An informal extended exclamation expressing relief, comfort or satisfaction.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam komunikasi santai, seruan yang dipanjangkan untuk menunjukkan rasa lega, nyaman atau puas.
senses.nuances: 这是聊天中依语境理解的表达功能，不应当作 ahhh 已获规范词典独立收录的义项。通常伴随舒缓的语气；若没有后文或表情，读者可能误解为不耐烦。下列组合是自然话语接续。

senses.zh_definition: 啊，原来如此；在聊天中表示突然理解或想起某事。
senses.en_definition: An informal exclamation marking sudden understanding or recollection.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam perbualan santai, seruan yang menandakan seseorang baru memahami atau teringat akan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 表示领悟时，标准改写通常用 oh 或原来如此的完整表述更明确；并非每个 ahhh 都能机械替换成 ah。此处同样是语境功能，以下为话语组合。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam analisis komunikasi digital itu, ejaan tidak baku “ahhh” dikenal pasti sebagai seruan yang maknanya bergantung pada konteks.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该数字通信分析将非规范拼写“ahhh”识别为一种含义取决于语境的感叹表达。
dual_scenarios.en: The analysis of digital communication identified the nonstandard spelling “ahhh” as an exclamation whose meaning depends on context.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: ahhh, lega! Dah siap semua kerja.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya berasa lega kerana semua kerja sudah selesai.
dual_scenarios.zh: 啊，终于松口气！活儿全干完了。
dual_scenarios.en: Ahhh, what a relief! All the work's done.
spoken_features: 重复 h 模拟声音延长。
dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略。
省略主语，感叹句与短句连用。
标准对应句按实际情绪改写，不逐字保留非规范拼写。

messages.speaker: Aina (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: ahhh, lega! Dah siap semua kerja.
messages.ms_standard: Saya berasa lega kerana semua kerja sudah selesai.
messages.zh: 啊，终于松口气！活儿全干完了。
messages.en: Ahhh, what a relief! All the work's done.

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合熟人聊天及表现声音的非正式文字。正式报告可在分析或引用原话时保留 ahhh，普通公文正文则应明确写出情绪或意思。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合熟人聊天及表现声音的非正式文字。正式报告可在分析或引用原话时保留 ahhh，普通公文正文则应明确写出情绪或意思。

etymology.historical_story: Ahhh is best understood as expressive spelling, not a separate inherited lexical root. Its standard counterpart, ah, belongs to Malay's interjections. In informal digital writing, repeated letters can suggest a drawn-out voice and supply emotional cues otherwise carried by speech. This explains its form without assigning it an unsupported ancient borrowing history.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hhh 看成拖长的气息：ahhh＝“啊——”；后面的句子告诉你是放松、领悟，还是不耐烦。

senses.en_definition: The name of the eighteenth letter of the Arabic alphabet, ع, with the traditional numerical value of seventy.
senses.ms_definition: Huruf ke-18 abjad Arab yang mempunyai nilai 70.

etymology.historical_story: Malay ain preserves the Arabic letter name ʿayn. An interesting distinction appears in its spelling: ع is the single letter, while عين spells out its name. The same character belongs to both Arabic and Jawi, but Kamus Dewan assigns it different positions in their respective alphabets. This makes ain a useful reminder that a shared letter need not occupy a shared alphabetical position. [Source: PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=139612&keyword=ain).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住一组对照：ain → ع；ghain → غ。ain 上面没有点，ghain 上面多一点；عين 则把 ain 的名称完整写出来。

etymology.historical_story: A proposed origin connects the metal name ayan with Hokkien a-iân, written 亞鉛. However, accounts differ over the direction of borrowing, so that route should remain provisional. DBP securely records the meaning zinc and separately lists an identical disease name. Shared spelling therefore does not establish a shared origin for the two words. [Etymological proposal](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/ayan) [Alternative borrowing account](https://skartchian.neocities.org/chewdict)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: a.yan 两拍记成“阿—央”；把它写在一块标着 Zn 的金属片上，锁定“锌”。疾病义另开一张卡记忆。

etymology.historical_story: Arjun is attested as a personal name in Malaysian institutional publications. The similar form arjuna has a separate Malay dictionary entry with literary meanings involving a heroic or beloved man. Similar spelling alone does not establish that the packet intends this word, a name, or another usage. Its intended etymology therefore remains unresolved. Sources: [Sunway University](https://sunwayuniversity.edu.my/news/2024/how-lancaster-sunway-partnership-helped-phd-candidate-arjun), [PRPM: arjuna](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=176312&keyword=arjuna).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 若语境指人，就把 Arjun 与姓名牌联系起来；先记住“这是名字”，不要凭相似拼写把它当成 arjuna 的普通词义。

etymology.historical_story: The spelling ass can represent several unrelated uses in material encountered by Malay readers: an English animal name, an insult, a vulgar body-part term, or an informal greeting abbreviation. Indonesian language publications document the shortening of assalamualaikum to Ass. That documented abbreviation does not establish its prevalence in Malaysia or explain an isolated corpus token. 缩写来源：[印尼语言机构出版物](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/28608/1/Geliat%20Bahasa%20dan%20Sastra%20pada%20Masa%20Pandemi.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: Adiwira combines adi-, conveying exceptional or superior status, with wira, meaning hero. These elements belong to Malay's Sanskrit-derived vocabulary, but their combination serves modern superhero discourse. DBP accepts the term and specifies one-word spelling. Its figurative use also lets speakers celebrate real people whose generosity or courage feels extraordinary. For adi, see [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=adi).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 wira＝英雄，再给它加上 adi- 这个“超常升级键”：adiwira＝超级英雄。

headword.verification_note: 这是规范词根 api 与 -nya 的组合形式，不代表另有独立词典条目。输入 Jawi اڤي 只拼写词根 api；完整 apinya 应写作 اڤيڽ。此处保留输入字段。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 附着在词尾，api 不发生音变，ny 表示 /ɲ/。此处 suffix 是字段分类；语法上须区分代词性附着成分与其他后置功能，不能一律解释为派生后缀。具体指代须结合上下文。

senses.zh_definition: 所指事物的火或火焰；-nya 将火与语境中的对象或人物联系起来。

senses.nuances: 继承词根 api 的红热义；这里不一定有可见火焰。[DBP：api](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=api)

etymology.historical_story: Apinya is transparently formed from api and the attached element -nya. The dictionary meanings of api extend from visible flame to glowing heat, electricity, and emotional intensity. This range lets one familiar image connect cooking, household utilities, and passionate speech. The attached form adds contextual reference rather than creating an unrelated root or a separate historical word. [DBP: api](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=api), [DBP: functions of -nya](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=teks+nya)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 分三拍读 a-pi-nya：api 是“火”，-nya 把这团火连回前文的人或物；想到炉子，就理解为“那个炉子的火”。

morphology.pattern_note: 借词整词作为独立词素记忆；三个音节 a.ro.ma，不拆成马来语词缀。

etymology.historical_story: Aroma belongs to an international vocabulary ultimately associated with Greek arōma, meaning spice, and its Latin continuation. Its Malay use fits a familiar sensory world of coffee, herbs, and fragrant cooking. The precise route into Malay is not established by the supplied packet, so a direct borrowing language should not be asserted. Modern Malay treats aroma as a whole root. [Collins etymology](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/aroma), [DBP usage](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=aroma)
