etymology.historical_story: Arang belongs to an inherited Austronesian word family linked to reconstructed Proto-Malayo-Polynesian *qajeŋ, meaning charcoal. Related forms include Javanese areng and Iban arang. The comparative dictionary distinguishes this material from glowing embers, associated with *baRa. Malay preserves that useful distinction in arang and bara: one names the charred material, while the other highlights its glowing, heat-bearing state. [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://ling.lll.hawaii.edu/dicts/ACD/acd-s_q.htm)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 a-rang，联想“啊，让木头慢慢炭化”，眼前出现一袋黑木炭。只是记忆联想，不是词源拆解；末尾 ng 合读 /ŋ/。

etymology.historical_story: Amsterdam takes its name from a dam in the River Amstel. The name preserves a practical feature of the settlement rather than a Malay word-building pattern. Amsterdam's municipal archive describes a thirteenth-century community beside that dam, whose inhabitants received a toll privilege in 1275. [Amsterdam City Archives](https://www.amsterdam.nl/publish/pages/943399/schatkamerbrochure_2023_a4_eng.pdf), [Municipal place-name register](https://data.amsterdam.nl/openbare-ruimten/0363300000003186)

etymology.historical_story: Atlantis reaches Malay as an international proper name rooted in Greek tradition. Plato's Timaeus and Critias describe an island kingdom overwhelmed by the sea. The name is associated with Atlas, the island's king in the narrative. Its memorable story supplies the cultural meaning; it is not a Malay compound. See [Atlantis: origin and history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Atlantis).

etymology.historical_story: Alaska preserves an Indigenous place-name rather than a Malay descriptive expression. The City of Unalaska traces it to Aleut forms Alaxsxa or Alaxsxix, referring to the mainland, which Russian speakers adopted as Alyaska. The name therefore carries an island community’s geographical perspective into its later international use. See [City of Unalaska](https://www.unalaska.gov/community/page/story-name-unalaska-or-dutch-harbor).

etymology.historical_story: Two histories meet in this spelling. The dictionary redirects one alfa to alfu, an Arabic borrowing meaning one thousand. Another alfa names the first Greek letter and appears in modern scientific vocabulary. Their identical spelling does not establish a shared origin. Remembering the two entries separately prevents an old numerical expression from being confused with a scientific symbol. Sources: [DBP: alfa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=alfa), [DBP: alfu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=alfu).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 alfa，先联想 alpha 和 α；遇到古旧词义，再连到 alfu＝一千。两个抽屉分开记。

etymology.historical_story: The andai family connects imagined situations with reasoning: andaian names an assumption, while mengandaikan means to suppose. Andainya turns that same idea into a condition introducing a clause. Kamus Dewan groups it with seandainya and related expressions. This family provides a useful bridge between everyday daydreaming, literary reflection, and the assumptions used in an argument. [DBP: andai](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=andai)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 andai 记成“按一个假设想一想”；andainya 一出现，脑中就接上“假如……”。这是意义联想，并非词源拆解。

senses.nuances: 此义在马来西亚双语商品描述及英语夹用中可见；DBP 英马词典所给马来语表达为 warna ambar 或 kuning jingga。下列为颜色描述框架，不代表已证实的马来语高频搭配。英语交通语境的 amber light 通常译为 lampu kuning。参见 [DBP 英马词典：amber](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=amber)。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)

messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu mahu gelang berwarna ambar ini atau yang berwarna hijau itu?

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 购物时可礼貌询问 Ini ambar asli atau bahan tiruan?“这是真琥珀还是仿制材料？”先询问材质，避免直接指责卖家。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合珠宝、博物馆及颜色描述。颜色名称不构成材质鉴定；香水中的 amber 香调也不能直接理解为琥珀树脂或龙涎香实物。正式马来语说明宜同时给出 ambar 或 resin terfosil。

etymology.historical_story: The English word amber reached European languages through a naming history involving Arabic anbar, originally associated with ambergris. The name later became attached to fossil resin, although the substances are different. Malay ambar preserves a related historical connection, while amber also appears as a DBP encyclopedia heading. [Amber nomenclature study](https://hrcak.srce.hr/en/file/209650), [DBP：ambar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=ambar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 amber 想成树脂凝住的一滴金黄色时光：实物是琥珀，颜色是琥珀色。

morphology.pattern_note: alah 是词根，不能拆为 a- + -lah。添加 meN- 时形成 mengalah；元音起首的词根保留，前缀呈 meng-。不同同形义项的派生关系须分别理解。

senses.zh_definition: 败；输；在竞赛、争斗或较量中未能取胜。
senses.en_definition: To lose or be defeated in a contest, struggle, or confrontation.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak memperoleh kemenangan dalam sesuatu pertandingan atau pertarungan; mengalami kekalahan.
senses.nuances: 本义常见于谚语、文学及较传统的表达；现代一般叙述常用 kalah 或 tewas。不要把 alah 直接理解为主动“让步”，后者通常用 mengalah 或 beralah。依据：[DBP PRPM：alah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=alah)。马来语释义为编写释义。

collocations.zh: 习惯之后，原本的艰难便不再难熬
collocations.en: Hardship becomes easier to bear through familiarity.

collocations.zh: 买时虽贵，用时却耐用划算
collocations.en: Pay more at purchase and gain through lasting use.

senses.zh_definition: 过敏的；身体对某种食物、药物或其他物质异常敏感，接触后可能产生不良反应。
senses.en_definition: Allergic to a substance, such as a food or medicine.
senses.ms_definition: Mempunyai kepekaan terhadap bahan tertentu sehingga pendedahan kepadanya boleh menyebabkan reaksi yang memudaratkan.
senses.nuances: 正式表达通常用 alah terhadap sesuatu；名词“过敏”用 alahan。此义不能一概等同于“不喜欢”或所有食物不耐受。DBP 明确建议在这个结构中使用 terhadap。依据：[DBP PRPM：alah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=alah)。马来语释义为编写释义。

collocations.zh: 对坚果或豆类过敏，具体种类由上下文确定
collocations.en: allergic to nuts or legumes, as specified by context

senses.zh_definition: 哎；哎呀；得了吧。表达轻微不满、无奈、遗憾，或用于劝说、催促，具体语气由上下文和语调决定。
senses.en_definition: An exclamation expressing annoyance, reluctance, regret, or coaxing, comparable to “oh” or “come on.”
senses.ms_definition: Seruan untuk meluahkan rasa terkilan, keberatan atau kurang senang, dan juga untuk memujuk atau mendesak seseorang.
senses.nuances: 实际词类是 kata seru（感叹词）；受指定词类选项限制，此处归入 particle。《Kamus Dewan》第四版收录此用法；PRPM 的一则 2024 年答复则指出《Kamus Dewan Perdana》未将其列为感叹词，因此正式编辑应按采用的词典与文体处理。依据：[DBP 旧版词典义项](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=alah%3B)、[DBP 用法答复](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=alah)。以下为口语表达组合，不是固定成语。

collocations.en: Come on, it'll only take a moment.

senses.zh_definition: 筑堰拦水，尤指为了捕鱼而拦截河水；这是主要通过派生词 mengalah 表现的罕用词根义。
senses.en_definition: A root meaning to dam a river, especially to catch fish, chiefly occurring in the derived verb mengalah.
senses.ms_definition: Akar kata bagi mengalah yang merujuk kepada perbuatan menyekat aliran sungai dengan bendungan, khususnya untuk menangkap ikan.
senses.nuances: 这是独立的同形义支，不能解释为“击败河流”。词典通过 mengalah 和 alahan 展示此义，不宜将裸词 alah 当作现代常用的独立动词。以下为派生形式的说明性组合，其高频性未经证实。依据：[DBP PRPM：alah III](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=alah%3B)。

collocations.en: a dam used to catch fish

dual_scenarios.context: 医疗记录 / 职场健康资料
dual_scenarios.ms: Menurut rekod perubatan, pesakit ini alah terhadap penisilin.
dual_scenarios.zh: 根据医疗记录，这名患者对青霉素过敏。
dual_scenarios.en: According to the medical record, this patient is allergic to penicillin.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友相约吃饭
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Alah, janganlah merajuk. Aku lambat sikit je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Alah, janganlah berkecil hati. Saya hanya lewat sedikit.

aku 适用于熟人之间
sikit 对应 sedikit
je 对应 sahaja
标准改写保留对话中的感叹语气；正式说明文可省去 alah

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)

messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah lama menunggu di sini.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 句首 Alah 可以显得亲近，也可能让对方觉得其感受被轻视。面对长辈、上司或认真投诉的人，宜使用明确、尊重的回应。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 过敏义适合直接说明具体致敏物。劝说义适用于熟人闲聊；对方表达健康问题或严重不满时，不宜用 Alah 淡化其处境。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries distinguish several homonymous entries spelled alah: defeat, allergic sensitivity, a river-damming root, and an exclamation. These should not automatically be treated as descendants of one proven historical meaning. The defeat sense survives memorably in proverbs, while the exclamation depends heavily on tone and conversational relationships. Dictionary evidence alone does not establish a shared ultimate origin. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=alah%3B)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记三个画面：比赛 alah＝输了；身体 alah terhadap＝对……过敏；开口 Alah!＝“哎呀！”同音要靠场景分义，不能混为一个意思。

headword.status_note: 按指定格式保留 official，不表示获得 DBP 标准词认证。DBP 的一则 2018 年答复指出其 PRPM 数据中不存在 akankah；此处提供辨识性释义及马来西亚标准语改写。音标按组成形式推读。

morphology.pattern_note: -kah 实际是附着性疑问小品词，而非一般派生后缀；此处按指定结构归入 suffix。组合时不发生鼻音同化或词根删音。可分析的构形不等于已获马来西亚规范认可。

word_family.gloss: 将；将会；此处指表示未来的助词用法

senses.zh_definition: 将会……吗；是否会……。由 akan 与疑问小品词 -kah 组成的形式，见于印尼语等语境；在马来西亚正式文本中宜按句义改写为 adakah … akan …。
senses.en_definition: An interrogative form meaning “will …?” or “will … happen?”, encountered particularly in Indonesian; Malaysian formal usage is better expressed as adakah … akan ….
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk gabungan akan dengan partikel tanya -kah untuk menanyakan sesuatu yang dijangka berlaku; dalam penulisan rasmi Malaysia, maksud ini boleh dinyatakan dengan binaan adakah … akan ….
senses.nuances: 此处 particle 是对整个疑问形式的功能性归类；akan 在此承担未来指向，-kah 标记疑问。不能将其释为“能够吗”，后者涉及 boleh。DBP 的 2018 年答复只说明当时数据库未收录，不能据此断言它在所有语言变体中均不合语法。以下组合用于辨识原文，其在马来西亚标准语中的高频性未经证实。依据：[DBP：关于 akankah 的答复](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=noted)、[DBP：-kah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=254640&keyword=kah)。马来语释义为编写释义。

collocations.zh: 他／她会来吗？马来西亚标准语可改为 Adakah dia akan datang?
这项努力会成功吗？马来西亚标准语可改为 Adakah usaha ini akan berjaya?

dual_scenarios.context: 编辑说明 / 跨语言文本审校
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam petikan tersebut, soalan "Akankah usaha ini berjaya?" boleh diungkapkan sebagai "Adakah usaha ini akan berjaya?" dalam bahasa Melayu standard Malaysia.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在该段引文中，问题“这项努力会成功吗？”可在马来西亚标准马来语中改写为“Adakah usaha ini akan berjaya?”。
dual_scenarios.en: In that quotation, the question “Akankah usaha ini berjaya?” can be expressed in standard Malaysian Malay as “Adakah usaha ini akan berjaya?”

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友讨论阅读中遇到的词
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku jumpa perkataan "akankah" kat sini. Maksudnya "akan ... ke", kan?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya menemukan perkataan "akankah" di sini. Adakah maksudnya sama dengan binaan "adakah ... akan ..."?
dual_scenarios.zh: 我在这儿看到“akankah”。意思就是“会……吗”，对吧？
dual_scenarios.en: I came across “akankah” here. It means “will …?”, right?
spoken_features: 目标词作为引述形式出现，避免将其包装为日常马来西亚口语
aku 是熟人用语
kat sini 对应 di sini
ke 是口语疑问标记
kan 用于向对方求证

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku jumpa "akankah" kat sini. Maksudnya "akan ... ke", kan?
messages.ms_standard: Saya menemukan "akankah" di sini. Adakah maksudnya sama dengan "adakah ... akan ..."?
messages.zh: 我在这儿看到“akankah”，就是“会……吗”的意思，对吧？
messages.en: I found “akankah” here. It means “will …?”, right?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya. Kalau nak tulis secara rasmi kat Malaysia, guna "adakah ... akan ..." je.
messages.ms_standard: Ya. Untuk penulisan rasmi di Malaysia, gunakan binaan "adakah ... akan ...".
messages.zh: 对。在马来西亚写正式文本时，用“adakah … akan …”就行。
messages.en: Yes. For formal writing in Malaysia, use “adakah … akan …”.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 疑问形式本身不表达敬意。询问上司或陌生人时，应配合适当称谓；提出请求时还须选择适合请求的句式。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合解释或引用印尼语等原文。马来西亚正式写作宜采用清晰的标准语改写；原文引用中的形式可保留，并按需要解释。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 疑问形式本身不表达敬意。询问上司或陌生人时，应配合适当称谓；提出请求时还须选择适合请求的句式。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合解释或引用印尼语等原文。马来西亚正式写作宜采用清晰的标准语改写；原文引用中的形式可保留，并按需要解释。

etymology.historical_story: Akankah is transparently formed from akan and the interrogative particle -kah. Its recognizable components can make it seem automatically interchangeable across Malay and Indonesian, but shared materials do not guarantee identical editorial conventions. A 2018 DBP advisory reported that akankah was absent from its database, making context and Malaysian reformulation especially useful for learners. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=noted)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: akan＝将会，-kah＝吗；合起来先读懂“将会……吗”。写马来西亚正式文本时，把疑问展开成 Adakah … akan …?

morphology.pattern_note: 阿拉伯语借词，在现代马来语中作为完整词根使用，不再拆分。词尾 b 在部分自然语流中可清化，出现输入包所列的 [ˈʔa.dap̚]。

senses.zh_definition: 体现于言语和行为中的礼貌、教养与端正品行。
senses.en_definition: Good manners, courtesy, and refinement in speech and behaviour.
senses.ms_definition: Kesopanan dan kehalusan budi yang ditunjukkan melalui percakapan serta perbuatan.
senses.nuances: 不仅指表面客气，也常包含尊重他人、懂得分寸和自我约束。kurang adab 是责备失礼的说法，语气可相当重。定义据 [DBP：adab](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=adab) 改写。

senses.zh_definition: 特定场合或人际关系中应遵循的行为礼仪与规范。
senses.en_definition: The accepted rules of conduct or etiquette for a particular situation.
senses.ms_definition: Tatacara berkelakuan yang wajar dan sopan dalam sesuatu keadaan atau hubungan.
senses.nuances: 常接活动或关系名称，说明某一领域的礼仪。与 adat 的传统习俗义不同，adab 侧重行为是否得体；具体规范应结合家庭、社群和场合理解。定义据 [DBP：adab](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=adab) 改写。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场：员工沟通培训
dual_scenarios.ms: Semua kakitangan diminta menjaga adab ketika berkomunikasi dengan pelanggan, termasuk semasa mengendalikan aduan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 所有员工与客户沟通时都应注意礼貌，包括处理投诉时。
dual_scenarios.en: All staff are asked to maintain courteous behaviour when communicating with customers, including when handling complaints.

dual_scenarios.zh: 去别人家要懂点礼貌嘛，进门前先打声招呼。
dual_scenarios.en: Let’s mind our manners at someone else’s house—greet them before going in.
spoken_features: kat 对应 di；nak 对应 hendak。
lah 用于提醒并强调共同遵守礼貌。
rumah orang 在此指别人家；bagi salam 是口语表达。

messages.ms_standard: Baiklah, saya hendak menunggu sehingga beliau menjemput kita masuk.
messages.zh: 知道啦，我会先等她请我们进去。
messages.en: Of course. I’ll wait for her to invite us in.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: adab 常用于谈尊重长辈、师长、客人及交谈对象。直接说别人 tak ada adab 或 kurang adab，可能被理解为指责其家教；提出具体请求通常更容易被接受。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于家庭教育、学校、职场、社交和宗教场合。马来西亚不同社群的问候与做客习惯有所不同，应留意主人的做法；提醒礼仪时宜针对具体行为，避免公开羞辱对方。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: adab 常用于谈尊重长辈、师长、客人及交谈对象。直接说别人 tak ada adab 或 kurang adab，可能被理解为指责其家教；提出具体请求通常更容易被接受。

etymology.historical_story: Adab is an Arabic loan associated with cultivated conduct and proper behaviour. In Malay, its meanings include both personal courtesy and the etiquette of particular situations. Malaysian Islamic educational discussions also connect adab with character and respect, helping explain why the word can carry moral weight beyond simple politeness. [Sources: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=adab), [IKIM](https://www.ikim.gov.my/adab-defines-islamic-education/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ada adab 想成‘有教养’：有 adab 的人，说话做事都让别人感到受尊重。

morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是附着于前词的强调语气小品词，此处借用 suffix 类别表示其位置，并非派生后缀；词根不发生音变。所给 Jawi اڠکت 仅对应词根 angkat，完整词形可写作 اڠکتله。

etymology.historical_story: Angkatlah combines the Malay verb angkat with the attached particle -lah. Its meanings connect physical raising with social elevation: hands can be raised, people appointed, and a language's standing elevated. Answering a telephone supplies another concrete connection through lifting the receiver. The particle adds interpersonal force rather than creating a separate action or changing the root's meaning.

etymology.historical_story: This entry records a practical abbreviation rather than a separate ancient word. Anak supplies the relationship, while ak saves space in a written personal name. The dictionary example Abon ak Jatim preserves that naming structure. Its value is cultural as well as linguistic: a short written marker can carry family identity without specifying the child's gender.

etymology.historical_story: Arizona preserves a regional place name recorded in Spanish colonial documents, but its deeper origin remains disputed. One explanation connects it with an O'odham expression referring to a small spring; another proposes Basque words referring to a good oak. The state library presents both interpretations, so neither should be taught as settled fact. [Arizona State Library](https://azsos.libguides.com/azalmanac/meaningofaz)

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan distinguishes two ajuk roots: one concerns imitation and mockery, the other sounding depths and probing feelings. Both produce the noun ajukan with -an. The proverb dalam laut boleh diajuk, dalam hati siapa tahu connects measurable sea depths with unknowable feelings, giving the probing sense a memorable place in Malay cultural expression. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=ajuk)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先找词根再理解：ajuk + -an 是“试探或模仿取笑这件事”；aju + -kan 才是“把问题或建议提出来”。

senses.nuances: 通常与地理中心词连用，如 Sungai Amazon、lembangan Amazon、hutan hujan Amazon。单独的 Amazon 不应一律翻译为购物平台。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pasukan perolehan akan membandingkan harga di Amazon dengan harga yang ditawarkan oleh pembekal tempatan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 采购团队将比较亚马逊平台与本地供应商的报价。
dual_scenarios.en: The procurement team will compare prices on Amazon with those offered by local suppliers.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku dah jumpa buku tu kat Amazon, tapi nak semak kos penghantaran dulu.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah menemukan buku itu di Amazon, tetapi saya mahu menyemak kos penghantaran terlebih dahulu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我已经在亚马逊找到那本书了，不过想先看看运费。
dual_scenarios.en: I found that book on Amazon, but I want to check the shipping cost first.

messages.en: Go ahead and check. If it costs too much, we can look in a local shop.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 品牌名本身没有敬语差别；正式文件使用 Amazon 的规范大写，并按需要说明所指的平台或企业。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 购物语境中可直接使用；讨论地理、生态或原住民文化时，应明确说 Sungai Amazon、hutan hujan Amazon 或具体地区名称。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 品牌名本身没有敬语差别；正式文件使用 Amazon 的规范大写，并按需要说明所指的平台或企业。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 购物语境中可直接使用；讨论地理、生态或原住民文化时，应明确说 Sungai Amazon、hutan hujan Amazon 或具体地区名称。

etymology.historical_story: Amazon explains that its name evokes the Amazon River: the ambition was to offer a selection as vast as the river. Its online bookstore opened in July 1995. This connection gives learners a useful cultural bridge between a South American geographical name and a company name encountered in Malaysian shopping conversations. [Amazon naming history](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/books-and-authors/books-are-in-our-dna); [opening date](https://ir.aboutamazon.com/faqs/default.aspx).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象亚马孙河汇聚无数支流，Amazon 平台汇聚无数商品；看到 Sungai 或 hutan，则切换到地理含义。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中作为完整借词处理，不拆成 al- 或其他马来语词缀。此处不以专业复合词冒充派生词族。

senses.zh_definition: 为解决问题而依次遵循的一组明确指令、规则或步骤，尤用于数学和计算机领域。
senses.en_definition: A specified sequence of instructions, rules, or procedures followed to solve a problem, especially in computing.
senses.ms_definition: Satu siri atau set arahan, peraturan atau prosedur yang diikuti untuk menyelesaikan masalah, terutama dalam komputer.
senses.nuances: 释义据 [DBP：algoritma](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?keyword=algoritma)，将原文缩写展开。DBP 所列的一般程序义与计算机义高度重叠，此处合并。算法可以先写成步骤、流程图或伪代码，再由程序实现；社交媒体语境中常特指内容推荐或排序所采用的计算规则。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pasukan pembangunan menambah baik algoritma carian bagi mengurangkan masa pemprosesan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 开发团队改进了搜索算法，以缩短处理时间。
dual_scenarios.en: The development team improved the search algorithm to reduce processing time.

dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya hanya menonton satu video kucing, kemudian algoritma itu terus mencadangkan video kucing.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我就看了一个猫咪视频，之后算法就老给我推猫咪视频。
dual_scenarios.en: I watched one cat video, and now the algorithm keeps recommending more.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 属于中性专业词。与非技术听众交流时，可先解释为 langkah penyelesaian masalah（解决问题的步骤）。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于教学、技术讨论及平台推荐机制的日常交流。马来西亚标准拼写使用 algoritma；不要把算法一概等同于人工智能。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 属于中性专业词。与非技术听众交流时，可先解释为 langkah penyelesaian masalah（解决问题的步骤）。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于教学、技术讨论及平台推荐机制的日常交流。马来西亚标准拼写使用 algoritma；不要把算法一概等同于人工智能。

etymology.historical_story: The international term behind algoritma ultimately comes from the Latinised name of al-Khwarizmi, a ninth-century mathematician who wrote about calculation with Hindu-Arabic numerals. His name became associated with arithmetic methods in Latin Europe. The meaning later broadened to systematic problem-solving procedures, connecting a medieval scholar's name with modern computing vocabulary. [MacTutor](https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Biographies/Al-Khwarizmi/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把算法想成“按规矩走步骤”：algoritma 像食谱，输入材料，按明确步骤处理，得到结果；这只是记忆比喻。

morphology.pattern_note: 按资料包作为独立词目处理。词义与 anak（孩子）相关，但不把词尾机械套入现代生产性后缀规则；内部 k 通常实现为喉塞音 /ʔ/。

senses.zh_definition: 对子女的温雅、亲爱称谓，常用于书信，也见于王室家庭语体；可用于称呼子女或子女自称。
senses.en_definition: A refined or affectionate term for a son or daughter, especially in correspondence and royal family usage.
senses.ms_definition: Anak, sebagai panggilan dalam bahasa halus atau bahasa istana, terutama dalam surat-menyurat.
senses.nuances: 不区分儿子或女儿，也不专指幼童。父母可用来称呼子女；子女写信给父母时也可借此自称。比 anak 文雅，普通聊天中带有郑重、文学或刻意亲昵的色彩。依据：[PRPM：anakanda](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=36924&keyword=anakanda)。

dual_scenarios.context: 正式家书 / 祝贺信
dual_scenarios.ms: Ayahanda dan bonda mengucapkan tahniah kepada anakanda atas kejayaan menamatkan pengajian.
dual_scenarios.zh: 父母祝贺你顺利完成学业。
dual_scenarios.en: Your father and mother congratulate you on completing your studies.

句末 ke 构成口语疑问

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 适合温雅家书、长辈寄语及相关王室语境。并非只有王室才能使用，但正式王室称谓应遵循具体礼仪。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 不宜随意用来称呼成年同事或陌生人，否则可能显得居高临下。家庭聊天中使用，通常带文学趣味或明显亲昵感。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 不宜随意用来称呼成年同事或陌生人，否则可能显得居高临下。家庭聊天中使用，通常带文学趣味或明显亲昵感。

etymology.historical_story: Anakanda belongs to the refined vocabulary of Malay family relationships. Its association with letters and royal households preserves a style in which kinship terms communicate affection together with respect. Unlike everyday anak, it gives a message a ceremonial or literary warmth. This cultural history is better established here than any proposed remote origin of its ending.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住 anak＝孩子，再想象把这个称呼写进一封郑重而温柔的家书：anakanda＝亲爱的孩子。

morphology.pattern_note: c 读 /t͡ʃ/。元音起首词根接 meN- 时用 meng-：meng- + acu → mengacu，不删除词根首音。DBP分列 acu I、II、III，不能据同形断定同源。

senses.zh_definition: 举起或指向武器、拳头等，以威吓他人。
senses.en_definition: To make a threatening gesture, especially with a weapon or fist.
senses.ms_definition: Mengancam melalui gerak senjata, penumbuk atau seumpamanya.

senses.en_definition: To mould or cast by pouring liquid material into a mould.
senses.ms_definition: Membentuk bahan cair dengan menuangkannya ke dalam acuan.
senses.nuances: acu II；动词用 mengacu；acuan 是名词“模具”。

senses.zh_definition: 短暂穿戴衣物或鞋子，检查是否合身。
senses.en_definition: To try on clothing or footwear to check the fit.
senses.ms_definition: Memakai pakaian atau kasut sebentar untuk memeriksa kesesuaiannya.
senses.nuances: acu III；用 mengacu 或 mengacukan。日常也可说 mencuba。

senses.zh_definition: 试着做；在吉兰丹等地方口语中用于引出请求或指示，相当于“试试看、请……一下”。
senses.en_definition: In regional speech, to try; also used to introduce a request or instruction.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam pertuturan daerah, cuba; digunakan juga untuk mengajak atau meminta seseorang melakukan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 此处可直接用 acu；地方用例见[DBP吉兰丹方言资料](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=cuba)。正式表达宜用 cuba；[DBP语言咨询](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=acu)指出 acu cuba 语义重复。

etymology.historical_story: A traditional cake mould offers a memorable cultural image for acu: liquid batter receives a shape from its container. That image helps explain the moulding sense and the related noun acuan. It is a teaching illustration, not evidence that threatening, referring and trying on clothes developed from one historical meaning. The deeper origin remains unverified.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: a-cu 读“啊—出”，c 像英语 chair 的起音；想象糕点从模具里“出”来，记住浇铸义。其余义项分组记忆，勿强作同源解释。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中作为完整词根处理；ng 表示单一辅音 /ŋ/。派生 mengangkuhkan 时，元音起首的词根前采用 meng-。

word_family.gloss: 使显得傲慢；与 diri 连用表示自抬身价

senses.zh_definition: 傲慢的；自视高人一等、轻视他人的。
senses.en_definition: Arrogant or haughty; regarding oneself as superior to others.
senses.ms_definition: Mempunyai sifat atau watak suka meninggi diri; congkak, sombong, pongah atau tinggi hati.
senses.nuances: 明确带贬义，通常批评人的态度、言语或行为；不能用来表达健康的自信或对成就的欣慰。释义依据 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=angkuh)。

senses.zh_definition: 外貌；容貌。见于米南加保地区用语及相关固定表达。
senses.en_definition: Appearance or looks, in regional Minangkabau usage.
senses.ms_definition: Rupa, dalam penggunaan Minangkabau; turut dicatat dengan pengertian serupa dengan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 标为 Mn 的另一同形词，不能据此将现代标准语中的 angkuh 普遍理解为“外貌”。以下是词典记录的地区固定表达，并非现代高频搭配；该地区词条也包含“相似”的用法。

collocations.zh: 讽刺外貌好看、举止却不佳的人
collocations.en: a regional proverb mocking good looks paired with poor conduct

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 直接对人说 Awak angkuh 属于较重的指责。职场反馈宜指出具体行为，例如语气生硬或未回应问候，避免直接给人格下结论。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合批评自高自大或居高临下的态度；不宜仅因对方安静、害羞或不熟络便使用。地区义项不宜套入普通职场会话。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 直接对人说 Awak angkuh 属于较重的指责。职场反馈宜指出具体行为，例如语气生硬或未回应问候，避免直接给人格下结论。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合批评自高自大或居高临下的态度；不宜仅因对方安静、害羞或不熟络便使用。地区义项不宜套入普通职场会话。

etymology.historical_story: An 1852 Malay–English dictionary already records angkuh with meanings including arrogance and rudeness. This shows that its negative social meaning predates modern office life and social media. For present-day learners, it is best remembered as a complete root: its spelling does not justify splitting it into smaller Malay meaning-bearing parts. Source: [Crawfurd's dictionary](https://wallace-online.org/converted/pdf/1852_Crawfurd_WS5.2.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ang- 联想成中文“昂”：昂着头、看不起人，就是 angkuh。此为记忆联想，并非词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入包作为未加词缀的词根处理，不能把 an- 分析为前缀。IPA 为按拼写推定的宽式读音，未经方言录音核实；Jawi 与分节保留原包的 null。未确认固定派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 【砂拉越马来语方言】慢的；动作或事情进展迟缓的。
senses.en_definition: In Sarawak Malay, slow or taking a long time.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam dialek Melayu Sarawak, lambat atau tidak cepat.
senses.nuances: 方言义项由 [Borneo Dictionary](https://borneodictionary.com/melayu-sarawak/anton) 记录为 slow／lambat。未核实其为 DBP 标准马来语词条；status 按请求模板保留为 official，不应据此推断获得 DBP 规范认证。马来语释义为编者归纳。下列搭配和例句为教学拟例，搭配频率未经语料统计；不把方言义推广为全国通用义。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报中的方言说明
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam glosari ini, kata dialek Melayu Sarawak 'anton' diberikan padanan bahasa Melayu standard 'lambat'.
dual_scenarios.zh: 本词汇表将砂拉越马来语方言词 anton 对应为标准马来语的 lambat。
dual_scenarios.en: In this glossary, the Sarawak Malay word anton is matched with the standard Malay word lambat.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 熟悉砂拉越方言词汇的朋友交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Servis kat sini anton sangat. Kita dah tunggu setengah jam.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Perkhidmatan di sini sangat lambat. Kita sudah menunggu selama setengah jam.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这里上菜也太慢了，我们都等半小时了。
dual_scenarios.en: The service here is really slow. We've been waiting half an hour.
spoken_features: anton 是砂拉越马来语方言词，在此与常见马来西亚口语形式混用。
kat 对应 di；dah 对应 sudah。
servis 是日常交谈中常见的借词，这里标准化为 perkhidmatan。
例句是说明方言词义的拟例，不是经过录音核验的纯方言转写。

messages.speaker: Aina (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Servis kat sini anton sangat. Kita dah tunggu setengah jam.
messages.ms_standard: Perkhidmatan di sini sangat lambat. Kita sudah menunggu selama setengah jam.
messages.zh: 这里上菜也太慢了，我们都等半小时了。
messages.en: The service here is really slow. We've been waiting half an hour.

messages.speaker: Hakim (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Haah, aku nak tanya staf dulu. Mungkin makanan kita belum siap.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya hendak bertanya kepada petugas terlebih dahulu. Mungkin makanan kita belum siap.
messages.zh: 是啊，我先问问店员。可能我们的菜还没做好。
messages.en: Yeah, I'll check with the staff. Maybe our food isn't ready yet.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 直接说某人 anton 可能带有催促或嫌弃意味；面对长辈、顾客或不熟悉的人，宜说明具体延误，并用较委婉的标准语表达。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于理解此方言词的本地交流。面向全国读者的正式文件宜用 lambat；介绍方言时则可保留 anton 并加释义。不要默认所有砂拉越居民都使用此词。

etymology.historical_story: Regional dictionaries record anton as a Sarawak Malay word meaning slow. This illustrates how a familiar local expression can be absent from a packet based on a national dictionary. The consulted sources do not establish its earlier history or a donor language. Its documented regional meaning should therefore be distinguished from any speculative origin story.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 anton 想成一辆“按了启动，仍慢吞吞”的车：先记“慢”，再记“砂拉越方言”。这只是联想，不是词源。

morphology.formula: apa + hal → apa hal → apahal（非规范连写）
morphology.pattern_note: 由疑问表达 apa hal 连写而成，没有添加词缀，也不要求发生音段脱落。原始数据中的独立词根分析不适用于这一表达；DBP 指明应分写为 apa hal，且该短语属于口语。

senses.zh_definition: 为什么；怎么回事；用来询问某种情况或行为的原因。
senses.en_definition: Why; how come; used informally to ask the reason for something.
senses.ms_definition: Ungkapan percakapan untuk menanyakan sebab sesuatu berlaku atau sebab seseorang melakukan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 整体属于疑问短语，此处 adverb 表示其询问原因的功能，并不表示 DBP 将 apahal 收为标准副词。它可表达好奇、惊讶或不满，语气由上下文和语调决定。正式表达可用 mengapa 或 mengapakah。DBP 明确规定分写 apa hal，且不用于正式语境。参见 [DBP 语言咨询](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=apa+hal+)。

collocations.zh: 这又是为什么；怎么又这样

senses.zh_definition: 怎么了；出了什么事；用来询问眼前的状况或问题。
senses.en_definition: What's going on; what's the matter.
senses.ms_definition: Ungkapan percakapan untuk menanyakan perkara yang sedang berlaku atau masalah yang dihadapi.
senses.nuances: 可独立成问句。对朋友温和地说可表示关心；生硬地说 Apahal? 或 Apahal kau? 容易产生质问、挑衅感。正式或礼貌场合宜用 Apakah yang berlaku? 或 Ada apa-apa masalah?

collocations.en: what's the matter with him or her

dual_scenarios.context: 职场文稿 / 语言编辑说明
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam laporan rasmi, gantikan ungkapan percakapan 'apahal' dengan 'mengapakah' atau 'apakah yang berlaku', mengikut konteks.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在正式报告中，应根据语境，将口语表达 apahal 改为 mengapakah 或 apakah yang berlaku。
dual_scenarios.en: In formal reports, replace the colloquial expression 'apahal' with 'why' or 'what happened', as appropriate to the context.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友询问突然离开的原因
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Apahal kau balik awal sangat ni?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Mengapakah kamu pulang begitu awal?
dual_scenarios.zh: 你怎么这么早就回去了？
dual_scenarios.en: How come you're heading home so early?
spoken_features: apahal 是 apa hal 的非规范连写。
kau 是熟人之间使用的人称代词。
ni 是 ini 的口语形式，在句末突出当前状况。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Apahal kau balik awal sangat ni? Baru je sampai.
messages.ms_standard: Mengapakah kamu pulang begitu awal? Kamu baru sahaja tiba.
messages.zh: 你怎么这么早就走啊？不是才刚到吗？
messages.en: How come you're leaving so early? You only just got here.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Adik aku dah tunggu kat rumah. Aku kena balik dulu.
messages.ms_standard: Adik saya sudah menunggu di rumah. Saya perlu pulang dahulu.
messages.zh: 我弟弟妹妹还在家等我，我得先回去了。
messages.en: My younger sibling is waiting at home. I need to head back.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 只适合熟悉的人之间的随意交流。对长辈、上司或陌生人直接说 Apahal? 容易显得不耐烦；可改说 Ada apa-apa masalah?。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 聊天中可用于关心或惊讶，但提高音量、配上 kau 或不友善的表情可能构成挑衅。正式公文中应换用标准疑问表达；status 标为 nonstandard 是因为 apahal 的连写不符合 DBP 建议。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 只适合熟悉的人之间的随意交流。对长辈、上司或陌生人直接说 Apahal? 容易显得不耐烦；可改说 Ada apa-apa masalah?。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 聊天中可用于关心或惊讶，但提高音量、配上 kau 或不友善的表情可能构成挑衅。正式公文中应换用标准疑问表达；status 标为 nonstandard 是因为 apahal 的连写不符合 DBP 建议。

etymology.historical_story: Apahal shows how an everyday question can acquire a joined spelling in informal writing. Its source is the phrase apa hal, literally asking what matter is involved. Depending on context, the question asks what is happening or why something happened. DBP explicitly recommends the separated spelling and identifies the expression as conversational, making its register central to learning it. See [DBP language advice](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=apa+hal+).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: apa＝什么，hal＝事情；合起来先问“什么事？”，再引申为“怎么回事、为什么？”。

morphology.formula: ∅ + Abbott → Abbott（外来专名，整词记忆）
morphology.pattern_note: 通常写作 Abbott，采用英语姓名读音；双写 bb、tt 不表示马来语长辅音。输入材料不足以确认具体指称或普通马来语词条资格。

senses.zh_definition: 阿博特：英语姓氏；在马来语文本中作为专有名词使用。仅凭本词形无法确定具体人物。
senses.en_definition: Abbott, an English-language surname used as a proper name; the particular referent requires context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga bahasa Inggeris yang digunakan sebagai kata nama khas; orang yang dimaksudkan perlu dikenal pasti melalui konteks.
senses.nuances: 正文应大写 Abbott。不能把它直接释为“修道院院长”；相关英语普通名词是 abbot。这里提供姓氏解读，并不宣称存在已核实的 DBP 普通词条。以下为姓名使用框架，并非高频词汇搭配。姓氏背景见 [Ancestry 姓氏词典](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/Abbott)。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场汇报；假设 Abbott 为与会者姓氏
dual_scenarios.ms: Encik Abbott akan menghadiri mesyuarat tersebut sebagai wakil syarikat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 阿博特先生将作为公司代表出席该会议。
dual_scenarios.en: Mr Abbott will attend the meeting as the company's representative.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 同事确认访客是否到达
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Encik Abbott dah sampai kat lobi ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah Encik Abbott sudah sampai di lobi?
dual_scenarios.zh: 阿博特先生已经到大厅了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Has Mr Abbott arrived in the lobby yet?
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式。
kat 在这里对应标准语 di。
句末 ke 用于口语疑问。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Encik Abbott dah sampai kat lobi ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Encik Abbott sudah sampai di lobi?
messages.zh: 阿博特先生到大厅了吗？
messages.en: Has Mr Abbott arrived in the lobby yet?

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)

messages.ms_standard: Ya, beliau sudah sampai. Saya akan turun untuk menyambut beliau sekarang.
messages.zh: 到了，我现在下去接他。
messages.en: Yes, he has. I'm heading down to meet him now.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 称呼具体人物时，依其实际身份使用 Encik、Puan、Dr. 等称谓；首次联系可使用全名。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 保留本人姓名拼写，不根据姓氏推断其宗教、国籍或职业。若上下文指机构或品牌，应另行确认，不能套用人物释义。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 称呼具体人物时，依其实际身份使用 Encik、Puan、Dr. 等称谓；首次联系可使用全名。

etymology.historical_story: Abbott belongs to a surname tradition associated with the ecclesiastical title abbot. Such names could identify someone employed in an abbot's household or on monastery lands, rather than an actual religious superior. This background explains the name's historical associations, but it does not establish which person an isolated occurrence in a Malay corpus denotes. [Source: Ancestry](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/Abbott).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Abbott 连同 Encik Abbott 一起记：看到大写 A，先想到“阿博特先生”这个姓名。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词素记忆；ng 表示 /ŋ/，音节边界为 /aŋ.ka.ra/，不能拆成 ang- 与 kara。

senses.zh_definition: 恶行；残暴、凶狠或伤害他人的行为。
senses.en_definition: An evil, cruel, or violent act; wrongdoing.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan jahat yang melibatkan kebengisan, keganasan atau kezaliman.
senses.nuances: 带明显谴责色彩，常见于新闻、文学及道德评价，语气重于普通的 kesalahan。

senses.zh_definition: 凶猛的；残暴的；具有野蛮攻击性的。
senses.en_definition: Ferocious, savage, or violently cruel.
senses.ms_definition: Buas atau ganas, khususnya tentang binatang atau pihak yang bertindak bengis.
senses.nuances: 此形容词义带文学色彩；日常描述动物时，buas 或 ganas 通常更自然。下列为典型用法组合。

senses.zh_definition: 自私贪婪的；为满足私欲而不顾他人的。
senses.en_definition: Selfish, grasping, or greedily indifferent to others.
senses.ms_definition: Mementingkan diri sendiri serta bersifat serakah atau tamak.
senses.nuances: 常见于固定组合 angkara murka。此处不能只按现代常见的 murka“震怒”理解整个组合。

senses.zh_definition: 无礼、猥亵或侵犯他人的行为，尤指古典叙事中对女性的冒犯。
senses.en_definition: An insolent or indecent act, especially an outrage against a woman in classical usage.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan sastera lama, perbuatan biadab atau cabul terhadap seseorang, khususnya perempuan.
senses.nuances: DBP 标记 sl，指 sastera lama。以下为古典语境用法，不宜当作现代法律或投诉中的精确术语；现代应按事实使用 gangguan seksual、pencabulan 等名称。[参见 PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=angkara)。

collocations.ms: berbuat angkara terhadap anak gadis orang
collocations.zh: 冒犯或侵犯别人家的女儿
collocations.en: commit an outrage against someone's daughter

senses.zh_definition: 造成坏结果的祸因或作祟行为；置于原因来源前时，可译为“都是……惹的祸”。
senses.en_definition: A blameworthy cause or agency behind an undesirable outcome.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan atau pengaruh yang dipersalahkan sebagai punca sesuatu kejadian buruk.
senses.nuances: 这是由“恶行”延伸的归责用法，常见于新闻标题和口语。angkara fitnah 可理解为 akibat angkara fitnah，不能把 angkara 当作适用于一切中性原因的 kerana。相关标题用例见 [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=angkara)。

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 公共设施遭破坏
dual_scenarios.ms: Pihak berkuasa sedang menyiasat kerosakan kemudahan awam yang dipercayai berpunca daripada angkara pihak yang tidak bertanggungjawab.
dual_scenarios.zh: 当局正在调查公共设施损坏事件，初步相信是不负责任者的恶行所致。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合谴责恶行、讨论社会问题或文学人物。面对无心的小失误，使用 kesilapan 或 tersilap 通常更合适；朋友间也可夸张调侃，但须留意语气。

etymology.historical_story: Angkara is linked to Sanskrit ahaṃkāra, associated with self-consciousness and pride. Its Malay meanings foreground selfishness, cruelty and harmful conduct. This semantic connection offers a memorable route from excessive concern with oneself to disregard for others, although that explanatory route should not be mistaken for a fully documented sequence of historical changes. [Source: Sanskrit loanword study](https://sealang.net/archives/nusa/pdf/nusa-v41.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 angkara siapa?＝“谁惹的祸？”；从“祸”联想到恶行、凶暴和贪横。

morphology.pattern_note: 历史拼写中的 oe 表示 /u/，不是两个独立元音；所列 IPA 按对应词 adun 重建。以下词族采用现代拼写，限定于修饰、打扮义。

senses.zh_definition: 【历史拼写；古典文学用语】经过装扮而显得美丽、整洁、雅致的；对应现代词典的 adun II。
senses.en_definition: Historical spelling of literary adun: beautiful or elegant through adornment.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan lama bagi adun dalam pengertian kelihatan cantik atau kemas setelah dihias atau didandankan.

etymology.historical_story: An older Malay–Dutch dictionary records adoen as neat or elegantly dressed and lists related forms for dressing up. Its spelling preserves oe for the vowel /u/. Modern DBP records the corresponding adornment sense under literary adun II. This establishes a historical spelling connection, rather than evidence that adoen is a separate modern Malaysian word.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先把旧拼写 oe 换成 u：adoen → adun；再联想“打扮一番，仪容雅致”。

morphology.pattern_note: 按历史马来语拼写解释时，oe 表示 /u/，不读成两个元音；所列 IPA 按 adu 重建。以下词族采用现代拼写；实际语义由派生形式和语境决定。

word_family.gloss: 较量；碰撞；另有王室用语“就寝”

senses.ms_definition: Ejaan lama bagi adu dalam keluarga kata yang berkaitan dengan menyampaikan kesusahan atau ketidakpuasan untuk mendapatkan bantuan.
senses.nuances: 现代完整句通常使用 mengadu 或 mengadukan，不把词根 adu 当作所有场合都可直接替换的动词。这里采用历史马来语词典的对应关系；孤立字形 adoe 在其他语言或文本中可能有不同解释。搭配使用现代对应形式。依据：[Mayer 历史词典扫描本](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/65/Practisch_Maleisch-Hollandsch_en_Hollandsch-Maleisch_handwoordenboek_%28IA_afu7948.0001.001.umich.edu%29.pdf)、[DBP：adu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=adu)。

senses.zh_definition: 【历史拼写，对应 adu】使双方较量、比试或相互碰触；相关派生词也可表示碰撞。
senses.en_definition: Historical adu associated with pitting opponents against each other, competing or bringing things into contact.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan lama bagi adu dalam keluarga kata yang merujuk pertandingan, pelagaan atau pertemuan dua benda.
senses.nuances: 具体结构决定意思：beradu tenaga 是比试力量，mengadu nasib 是碰运气，beradu 也能表示碰撞。不能把所有含 adu 的词组统译为“投诉”。

collocations.en: try one's luck or seek one's fortune

senses.zh_definition: 【历史拼写，对应同形词 adu II；王室用语】就寝、睡眠，通常见于 beradu。
senses.en_definition: Historical adu in the royal-register family meaning to sleep or retire to bed.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan lama bagi adu dalam penggunaan diraja, khususnya beradu yang merujuk tidur bagi raja.
senses.nuances: 这是与投诉、较量词族分列的同形词义。beradu 的王室睡眠义及 peraduan 的寝处义须依语境辨别，不能由现代常见的“比赛”义机械推断。

etymology.historical_story: Older Malay dictionaries use adoe where modern spelling has adu, with oe representing /u/. Historical entries document complaint and contest meanings, while related royal vocabulary concerns sleep. Modern DBP likewise distinguishes lexical entries and derived forms. The spelling is therefore a useful clue when reading old books, but it cannot determine a passage's meaning without context.

etymology.historical_story: The Atlantic takes its name from Atlas in Greek mythology. Malay uses the geographical form Atlantik in Lautan Atlantik. The mythological association provides a memorable link between an ancient name and a modern ocean label; it does not mean that Atlantik contains meaningful Malay prefixes or suffixes. [NOAA](https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/atlantic.html)

etymology.historical_story: Marvel's Avengers first appeared in Avengers number one in 1963, written by Stan Lee and drawn by Jack Kirby. The English name is the plural of avenger, someone who seeks retribution. In Malay discussion of these stories, Avengers functions as a retained proper name rather than a word formed with Malay affixes. Sources: [Marvel](https://www.marvel.com/comics/issue/6951), [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/avenger).

etymology.historical_story: English agent ultimately comes from Latin agere, meaning to do or act. Its history connects an acting force with someone acting for another person. Malay adapted the English source into ejen and agen, distinguishing representation from causal action in many contexts. The unchanged spelling agent remains English. Sources: [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/agent), [DBP](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2025/01/06/17021/).

etymology.historical_story: The friendship adjective belongs to the Arabic borrowing layer in Malay: Arabic aqrab expresses greater nearness, which Malay applies to close personal relationships. A separate homonym names Scorpius and comes from Arabic ʿaqrab, ‘scorpion’. Their identical Roman spelling conceals distinct origins, so closeness and the constellation should be remembered separately. [Arabic borrowing study](https://e-journal.uum.edu.my/index.php/rentas/article/download/19072/4744/97509), [homonym distinction](https://phabricator.wikimedia.org/T261507)

etymology.historical_story: Arti and Malaysian Malay erti belong to the South Asian borrowing history of the region and are associated with Sanskrit artha, ‘meaning’ or ‘purpose’. Their differing initial vowels reflect established regional word forms. The final i is part of the borrowed lexical form, not evidence that Malay added a suffix to an independent root art. [Hoogervorst: South Asian lexical influence](https://brill.com/display/book/9789004529458/BP000002.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: English apartment came through French appartement and Italian forms associated with a separate dwelling or set of rooms. That idea of separation helps explain its modern meaning: an independent home within a larger building. Malaysian Malay uses the adapted spelling apartmen alongside pangsapuri, while the English spelling can appear in language mixing. [Etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/apartment), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=apartmen)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 apart，想象大楼被分成一户户独立空间：apartment 就是其中一套公寓。这是记忆联想，不是马来语构词拆分。

morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语夹英语表达中作为整词使用，不按马来语词缀拆分。输入音节 sst 是无效占位值，此处仅按要求保留；英语音节可记作 ac.tion，共两音节。IPA 表示英语读法；本地“摆架子”义也可读近 /ekʃen/。未提供或核实此英语拼写的规范爪夷文。

etymology.historical_story: English action entered multilingual Malaysian conversation alongside many other English expressions. In local speech, action or eksyen can describe someone who shows off, a meaning quite different from taking action. This contrast makes the word a useful example of borrowing with semantic change: familiar English spelling does not guarantee familiar English meaning.

etymology.historical_story: Again descends from Old English forms such as ongēan, associated with opposition or facing back. Its modern meanings connect returning to an earlier state with doing something another time. That history helps explain why Malay translations vary between lagi, sekali lagi, semula, and kembali rather than following one fixed equivalent. [Oxford word origin](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/again).

etymology.historical_story: Ascendant entered English through French from a Latin participle meaning climbing upward. Its history links physical ascent with the rising zodiac and, figuratively, increasing influence. The same upward image explains its political use: a party described as ascendant is gaining power. This is an English word history, not evidence of an established Malay borrowing. [Source: Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/ascendant).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把第二音节 /send/ 联想到向上发送的箭头：位置向上、势力增强，就是 ascendant。此联想仅供记忆。

dual_scenarios.zh: 在面向马来西亚读者的译文中，印尼语词 apartemen 改用 pangsapuri。
dual_scenarios.en: In the translation for Malaysian readers, the Indonesian word 'apartemen' is replaced with 'pangsapuri'.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 讨论印尼住宿广告
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Iklan ni tulis 'apartemen' sebab tempat tu kat Jakarta.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Iklan ini menggunakan perkataan 'apartemen' kerana penginapan itu terletak di Jakarta.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这广告写 apartemen，是因为住处在雅加达。
dual_scenarios.en: The ad says 'apartemen' because the place is in Jakarta.
spoken_features: ni、tu 分别是 ini、itu 的口语形式
kat 对应标准语的 di
dah 对应 sudah；je 对应 sahaja

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah jumpa iklan 'apartemen' kat Jakarta ni. Nak tengok?
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah menemukan iklan sebuah apartmen di Jakarta. Adakah kamu mahu melihatnya?
messages.zh: 我找到雅加达的一则公寓广告了，要看看吗？
messages.en: I found an apartment ad in Jakarta. Want to take a look?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Hantar je. 'Apartemen' tu pangsapuri, kan?
messages.ms_standard: Hantarkan sahaja. Perkataan 'apartemen' itu bermaksud pangsapuri, bukan?
messages.zh: 发来吧。apartemen 就是公寓，对吧？
messages.en: Send it over. 'Apartemen' means an apartment, right?

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 与印尼人交流时尊重其 apartemen 拼写；面向马来西亚机构或客户撰稿时采用当地惯用的 apartmen 或 pangsapuri。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合阅读印尼房源、旅游信息及跨境聊天。引用印尼广告时可保留原词；本地房地产公文宜采用马来西亚用词。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 与印尼人交流时尊重其 apartemen 拼写；面向马来西亚机构或客户撰稿时采用当地惯用的 apartmen 或 pangsapuri。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合阅读印尼房源、旅游信息及跨境聊天。引用印尼广告时可保留原词；本地房地产公文宜采用马来西亚用词。

etymology.historical_story: Apartemen belongs to the Indonesian vocabulary of urban housing. Its spelling reflects a borrowing from Dutch appartement, rather than a Malay prefix-and-root construction. Malaysian readers generally encounter apartmen or pangsapuri instead. The contrast offers a useful cultural lesson: closely related languages can describe the same modern dwelling with different established spellings. [Etymology and pronunciation](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/apartemen).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 apartemen 与英语 apartment 连起来记：同样是公寓；印尼拼写多一个中间的 e，马来西亚通常写 apartmen。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -an 构成名词；词根拼写不变，按资料包分为 an.dai.an 三个音节。

senses.zh_definition: 为说明论点或作比较而提出的假设性例子或设想，不一定是事实。
senses.en_definition: A hypothetical example or supposition used to explain an argument or make a comparison.
senses.ms_definition: Contoh atau misalan yang tidak semestinya merupakan kenyataan, dikemukakan untuk menjelaskan hujah atau dijadikan perbandingan.
senses.nuances: 此义突出论证中的假设情境，不表示所述事情已经发生。马来语释义依 DBP 原义展开缩写，未逐字引录。

senses.zh_definition: 尚未经证实而暂时接受的看法、判断或推论，常作为分析或行动的前提。
senses.en_definition: An unverified belief or proposition accepted provisionally, often as a basis for reasoning or action.
senses.ms_definition: Pendapat, kesimpulan atau anggapan yang tidak semestinya merupakan kenyataan.
senses.nuances: 可指中性的分析前提，也可指证据不足的主观推断；不必然表示猜测错误。所给频次排名沿用资料包，未独立核验其语料来源。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场汇报 / 分析报告
dual_scenarios.ms: Unjuran ini berdasarkan andaian bahawa permintaan akan kekal stabil sepanjang tahun hadapan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这项预测以明年全年需求保持稳定为假设前提。
dual_scenarios.en: This projection is based on the assumption that demand will remain stable throughout next year.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Jangan buat andaian dulu, dia belum balas je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Jangan membuat andaian dahulu; dia cuma belum membalas mesej.
dual_scenarios.zh: 先别乱猜，他只是还没回消息。
dual_scenarios.en: Don't jump to conclusions yet; they just haven't replied.
spoken_features: buat 对应较正式的 membuat。
dulu 对应 dahulu。
je 是 sahaja 的口语形式；此处表示‘只是’。
语境明确时省略 mesej。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dia dah baca mesej aku, tapi belum balas. Dia marah ke?
messages.ms_standard: Dia sudah membaca mesej saya, tetapi belum membalasnya. Adakah dia marah?
messages.zh: 他已经看了我的消息，可还没回。他生气了吗？
messages.en: They've read my message but haven't replied. Are they upset?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Jangan buat andaian dulu, dia mungkin sibuk je.
messages.ms_standard: Jangan membuat andaian dahulu; dia mungkin cuma sibuk.
messages.zh: 先别乱猜，他可能只是忙而已。
messages.en: Don't jump to conclusions yet. They might just be busy.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 指出他人的判断只是 andaian，可能带有质疑意味。职场中可说‘Andaian ini perlu disahkan’，把重点放在验证前提。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于研究、计划和日常推断。谈论他人的动机或私生活时，避免把 andaian 当成已证实的事实。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 指出他人的判断只是 andaian，可能带有质疑意味。职场中可说‘Andaian ini perlu disahkan’，把重点放在验证前提。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于研究、计划和日常推断。谈论他人的动机或私生活时，避免把 andaian 当成已证实的事实。

etymology.historical_story: Andaian belongs to the Malay family built around andai, associated with supposing and imagining possibilities. Adding the noun-forming suffix -an turns that activity into a supposition or hypothetical example. Its dictionary senses connect everyday judgments about people with the explicit assumptions used in arguments and analytical writing. No deeper historical origin is established by the supplied packet.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: andai 是‘假如’，加 -an 把‘假如……’装成一个名词：‘假设’。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中作为整词借词记忆，不拆成马来语词缀；词尾 k 在常见马来西亚读法中可实现为喉塞音 [ʔ]。没有需要强行补造的常用派生词。

word_family.gloss: 各种或多件人工遗物；全词重叠形式

senses.zh_definition: 由人制作、加工并留存下来的器物，尤指反映某个历史时期生活或文化的工具、武器等人工遗物。
senses.en_definition: A human-made object surviving from a particular period, especially a tool, weapon, or other object of historical interest.
senses.ms_definition: Objek buatan manusia, khususnya alat atau senjata, yang menjadi tinggalan sesuatu zaman.
senses.nuances: 重点是人的制作或加工痕迹，不要求一定具有艺术价值；天然化石通常不归入这一词义。马来西亚标准拼写为 artifak。[DBP：artifak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=artifak)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报：博物馆保存工作
dual_scenarios.ms: Pihak muzium sedang menjalankan kerja pemuliharaan terhadap artifak yang ditemukan di tapak arkeologi itu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 博物馆方面正在对该考古遗址出土的文物进行保护修复。
dual_scenarios.en: The museum is carrying out conservation work on artefacts discovered at the archaeological site.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流：朋友参观博物馆
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Artifak kat muzium tu menarik lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Artifak di muzium itu memang menarik.
dual_scenarios.zh: 那家博物馆的文物挺有意思的。
dual_scenarios.en: The artefacts at that museum are really interesting.
spoken_features: kat 对应表示地点的 di。
tu 是 itu 的口语缩略形式。
lah 在此表达感受和强调。

messages.ms_standard: Sudahkah kamu melihat artifak di galeri baharu itu?

messages.zh: 还没呢，我想这个周末去。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这是中性学术及博物馆用词。谈到具有宗教或族群意义的器物时，应使用展签或相关社群认可的名称。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合历史教育、考古和展览说明。参观时遵守触摸与拍摄规定，尊重相关社群对祭祀用品、陪葬品及祖传器物的解释。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这是中性学术及博物馆用词。谈到具有宗教或族群意义的器物时，应使用展签或相关社群认可的名称。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合历史教育、考古和展览说明。参观时遵守触摸与拍摄规定，尊重相关社群对祭祀用品、陪葬品及祖传器物的解释。

etymology.historical_story: Artifak belongs to an international vocabulary ultimately connected with Latin arte, meaning by skill, and factum, a thing made. The history points to human workmanship rather than artistic beauty: an ordinary tool can matter as much as an ornament. In Malay museum language, such objects provide material evidence of how earlier communities lived. [Etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/artifact).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 ar.ti.fak，联想到英语 artefact／artifact；抓住“人工做出来并留存的东西”，一把旧石斧也可以是 artifak。

morphology.pattern_note: 整段作为表达性声音记忆；重复 a 表示拖长声音，不是三个音节，也不是词缀或语法重叠。所列读音为示意性语音转写，实际时长和音调随情绪变化。ah 是相关感叹形式，不列为派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 啊——；用拖长的声音表示放松、满足或恍然明白，具体意义由语调和上下文决定。
senses.en_definition: A prolonged exclamation expressing relief, satisfaction, or sudden understanding.
senses.ms_definition: Seruan yang dipanjangkan untuk melahirkan rasa lega, puas atau baru memahami sesuatu, bergantung pada intonasi dan konteks.
senses.nuances: 实际语法类别为 kata seru；因限定词性列表没有 interjection，此处映射为 particle。aaah 是表达性拼写，本次未核实为 DBP 独立标准词目；status＝official 仅按要求保留为数据标签，不表示该拼写已获官方认定。马来文释义为编辑性描述，非官方引文。DBP 将感叹词说明为表达情感的功能词，见 [DBP：Morfologi—Kata Seru](https://jendeladbp.my/app/uploads/woocommerce_uploads/2025/04/eDigital_Morfologi-qnsczr.pdf)。下列为自然搭配示例，不作已验证词频排序。

senses.zh_definition: 啊！或哎呀！用拖长的喊声表达惊吓、疼痛、烦躁或抗拒。
senses.en_definition: A prolonged cry expressing alarm, pain, annoyance, or rejection.
senses.ms_definition: Jeritan atau seruan yang dipanjangkan untuk melahirkan rasa terkejut, sakit, geram atau tidak mahu menerima sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 属于对表达性声音的语境归纳，非已核实的官方多义项。不能仅凭字母数量判断情绪；aaah 也不能一律等同于表示肯定的 ya。标准 ah 可表达不喜欢或拒绝，见 [DBP：kata seru 的用法](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=seru)。下列为语境示例。

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻报道中的原话引述；该表达性拼写保留在引号内

etymology.historical_story: Aaah is best understood here as expressive writing rather than a historically traceable lexical borrowing. Repeating the vowel visually stretches a vocal reaction, allowing a message or quoted dialogue to suggest how someone sounds. The interpretation depends on context and intonation. No verified evidence supplied here establishes an independent official Malay headword, a fixed Jawi spelling, or a particular historical origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 三个 a 把“啊——”拉长：先听语气，再判断是松口气、明白了，还是惊叫；字母变长不等于词义固定。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入将整词作为借入单位处理。历史上阿拉伯语 al- 是定冠词，kitāb 表示书；al- 不是这里的马来语派生前缀。以下词族项通过 kitab 形成历史联系，不是从 alkitab 直接派生。

word_family.gloss: 经书；古义亦指书籍（历史关联词）
有经典；以经书为依据（由 kitab 派生）

senses.zh_definition: 《圣经》；基督宗教的经典，由《旧约》和《新约》组成，名称通常写作 Alkitab。
senses.en_definition: The Bible, the Christian scriptures comprising the Old and New Testaments.
senses.ms_definition: Kitab suci agama Kristian yang merangkumi Perjanjian Lama dan Perjanjian Baru.
senses.nuances: 这是马来语基督宗教出版与社群中的实际用法，名称通常大写为 Alkitab；本义项的马来语释义为综合释义，非冒充 DBP 原文。不要将其与 DBP 的 al-Kitab 义项自动等同。[马来语《圣经》出版实例](https://www.alkitabversiborneo.org/en)。

senses.zh_definition: 《古兰经》的称谓之一；此义在 DBP 中写作 al-Kitab。
senses.en_definition: Al-Kitab, a designation for the Quran in Islamic usage.
senses.ms_definition: Al-Quran; Kitabullah.
senses.nuances: 此义对应 DBP 的 al-Kitab 词条。应保留其连字符和 Kitab 的大写，并根据宗教语境判断所指；输入的全小写 alkitab 不足以消除歧义。[DBP al-Kitab 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=al-Kitab)。

dual_scenarios.zh: 该出版社为基督徒读者提供马来语《圣经》译本。
dual_scenarios.en: The publisher provides a Malay translation of the Bible for Christian readers.

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 跨宗教讨论或翻译时，首次出现可明确写“Alkitab，经典为《圣经》”或“al-Kitab，此处指《古兰经》”。引用出版物时保留原书名、版本名及其大小写。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 尊重对方社群使用的经典名称；基督徒说 Alkitab 时，通常是在谈《圣经》，无需擅自改称其他宗教经典。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 跨宗教讨论或翻译时，首次出现可明确写“Alkitab，经典为《圣经》”或“al-Kitab，此处指《古兰经》”。引用出版物时保留原书名、版本名及其大小写。

etymology.historical_story: The name combines the Arabic definite article al with kitāb, meaning book: literally, the book. Its religious reference depends on tradition. Malay Christian publications use Alkitab for the Bible, while DBP records al-Kitab as a designation for the Quran. Shared linguistic ancestry therefore coexists with distinct community meanings and spelling conventions. [Christian usage](https://www.alkitabversiborneo.org/en), [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=al-Kitab).

etymology.historical_story: English alarm ultimately goes back through French to the Italian military call all'arme, urging people to take up arms. A warning shouted in danger developed into a word for warning signals and the devices producing them. Malaysian mixed speech uses the English form for familiar devices, including car alarms and phone reminders. [Etymological reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/alarm)

etymology.historical_story: The supplied Kamus Dewan entry records aha as an exclamation of understanding, surprise, or awareness. It supplies no historical derivation, so a specific donor language cannot responsibly be assigned here. Its memorable cultural role is conversational: it makes a private moment of recognition audible, allowing other speakers to hear that a connection has suddenly become clear.

etymology.historical_story: Avatar ultimately comes from Sanskrit avatāra, associated with a deity's descent into earthly form. English adopted the religious term and also developed a digital sense: an image or character representing someone online. That connection makes the modern meaning memorable—a person appears in a virtual space through another form. The religious and computing meanings are documented by the [American Heritage Dictionary](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=avatar).

etymology.historical_story: Always belongs to English, not to Malay word formation. Merriam-Webster traces it to Middle English alwayes, from alwey. Its modern meanings cover repeated occasions, lasting duration, and an available alternative. In a Malaysian conversation, inserting always into a Malay sentence illustrates code-switching; that conversational use should be distinguished from its status as an English dictionary headword. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/always)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 always 的开头联想成 all：所有相关时候都如此，就是“总是”；说永久承诺时则是“永远”。这是记忆联想，不是马来语构词。

morphology.formula: ambil → ambik（口语变体；无词缀添加）
morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入包的独立词头标记；实际对应规范词 ambil。部分口语中词末 /l/ 对应喉塞音 [ʔ]，常写成 k；所列读音是常见口语读法，地区间有差异。

word_family.gloss: 拿取；领取；接取；由规范词根 ambil 派生
领取；摄取；招收；由规范词根 ambil 派生

senses.zh_definition: 拿、取；把某物拿起、取出或带走。
senses.en_definition: To take, pick up, remove, or carry away something.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk percakapan bagi ambil: memegang sesuatu lalu mengangkat, mengeluarkan atau membawanya pergi.
senses.nuances: 非正式口语拼写，正式书写用 ambil 或按句法使用 mengambil。是否表示擅自拿走须看语境，本词本身不等于“偷”。释义参照规范词的[DBP 词条 ambil](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=ambil)，并非将 ambik 当作规范词形。

senses.zh_definition: 去领取所需物品，或去接某人。
senses.en_definition: To collect something or pick someone up.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk percakapan bagi ambil yang bermaksud pergi mendapatkan barang atau menjemput seseorang.
senses.nuances: 用于接孩子、接朋友、领取药物等。ambik anak 在接送语境中通常指“接孩子”，不是“领养孩子”；领养须有相应上下文。

senses.zh_definition: 与特定宾语搭配，表示拍摄、选修或参加某项学习与考试活动。
senses.en_definition: To take a photograph, course, subject, or test, as determined by the object.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk percakapan bagi ambil dalam ungkapan yang bermaksud menghasilkan gambar, mengikuti kursus atau menduduki ujian.
senses.nuances: 具体含义由宾语决定：ambik gambar 是拍照，ambik kursus 是修读课程，ambik ujian 是参加考试。不能把这些搭配中的 ambik 一律译成“拿”。

senses.zh_definition: 花费或占用时间、空间等资源。
senses.en_definition: To take up or require time, space, or similar resources.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk percakapan bagi ambil yang bermaksud menggunakan atau memerlukan masa, ruang dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 常用于说明任务耗时或物品占地方。正式书写恢复 ambil 或 mengambil；不是指用手拿取时间或空间。

etymology.historical_story: Ambik is an informal counterpart of standard Malay ambil, rather than a word created by adding a suffix. It illustrates how everyday speech and formal spelling can diverge. Learners should connect it with the standard ambil family, whose meanings include taking objects, collecting people or goods, photographing, and taking up time. [DBP: ambil](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=ambil)

morphology.formula: ∅ + aigoo → aigoo（韩语感叹词的非正式拉丁字母写法）
morphology.pattern_note: 在夹语中作为整词使用，不按马来语词缀拆分。对应韩语 아이고，常规罗马字写作 aigo；aigoo 中的 oo 不构成马来语词缀，也不自动表示音位性长元音。所列音值为韩语来源词的宽式参考，未确立统一马来语读音。

senses.zh_definition: 哎哟；唉。表达疼痛、疲惫、挫败或无奈的感叹。
senses.en_definition: An exclamation expressing pain, tiredness, frustration, or exasperation: oh dear, ouch, or goodness.
senses.ms_definition: Seruan daripada bahasa Korea untuk meluahkan kesakitan, keletihan, kekecewaan atau rasa tidak berdaya, mengikut konteks.
senses.nuances: 严格词类为感叹词，即 kata seru；此处因限定词性列表未含 interjection，归入 particle。未有足够依据将 aigoo 标为正式马来语词。以下为说明用组合，非经语料统计确认的高频固定搭配。[韩国国立国语院](https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=71354)

senses.zh_definition: 哎呀；天哪。表达惊讶、错愕或难以置信。
senses.en_definition: An exclamation expressing surprise, disbelief, or astonishment: oh my or goodness.
senses.ms_definition: Seruan daripada bahasa Korea yang menyatakan rasa terkejut atau sukar mempercayai sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 具体情绪依语调和上下文判断，不能一律译成抱怨。以下是马来语夹用示例；标准表达可用 wah、aduh 或其他与情境相符的感叹词。[韩国国立国语院](https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=71354)

senses.zh_definition: 哎哟；哎呀。带喜爱或欣喜语气的感叹，如见到可爱的孩子或久别的人。
senses.en_definition: An affectionate or delighted exclamation prompted by someone endearing or a welcome encounter.
senses.ms_definition: Seruan daripada bahasa Korea yang meluahkan rasa sayang, gembira atau sangat senang ketika melihat atau bertemu seseorang.
senses.nuances: 此义并不表示痛苦；温柔语调可表达喜爱。以下为说明性组合，不能据此推定它们已成为马来语固定搭配。[韩国国立国语院](https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=71354)

etymology.historical_story: Aigoo represents Korean 아이고 in informal Latin spelling. The Korean dictionary records reactions ranging from pain and frustration to delight and grief. This emotional range explains why a single spelling can resemble either a sigh or an affectionate exclamation. It should be learned as a whole expression, without inventing Malay roots. [韩国国立国语院](https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=71354)

morphology.pattern_note: antar 以元音开头，接 peN- 或 meN- 时分别形成 pengantar、mengantar，词根开头不发生辅音脱落。

senses.ms_definition: Kata dasar bagi pengantar, iaitu penerangan ringkas yang memperkenalkan kandungan buku, ceramah atau karya lain.
senses.nuances: 这是派生词 pengantar 的义项，应连同派生形式学习。kata pengantar 可译为“前言”或“序言”，具体取决于出版语境。依据：[DBP：antar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=antar)。

senses.zh_definition: 构成 pengantar 的词根；pengantar 在此指传递知识或信息所用的媒介，尤其是教学语言。
senses.en_definition: The base of pengantar in its sense of a medium for conveying information, especially a language of instruction.
senses.ms_definition: Kata dasar bagi pengantar yang merujuk kepada bahasa atau wahana untuk menyampaikan ilmu dan maklumat.
senses.nuances: 此义主要见于 bahasa pengantar。不要把 bahasa antar 当作“教学语言”的标准表达。依据：[DBP：antar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=antar)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve antar prominently through pengantar, a word connecting books, speech, and education. A kata pengantar introduces a written work, while a bahasa pengantar carries knowledge to learners. The dictionary also cross-refers antar to hantar. These connections offer a useful cultural picture of conveying something onward, but that picture is a learning interpretation, not proof of a single historical derivation. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=antar)

senses.nuances: 与 dunia“今世”相对。它不是 syurga“天堂”的同义词，也不直接表示投胎转世。dunia akhirat 可表示今世与后世，也可在求原谅等表达中强调永久与彻底。来源：[DBP：akhirat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=akhirat)。

etymology.historical_story: Akhirat is borrowed from Arabic ākhirah, referring to the hereafter. In Malay, its cultural significance appears clearly beside dunia: this worldly life is temporary, while the next life is enduring. DBP records both this religious meaning and the expression dunia akhirat, which can also emphasize lasting sincerity when someone asks forgiveness. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=akhirat).

etymology.historical_story: Arcadia began as the name of a mountainous Greek region. Literary tradition transformed the geographical name into an image of peaceful pastoral life, far removed from ordinary conflict. Its later figurative meaning describes an ideal rural world rather than the historical region itself. This is a European literary association, not an inherited Malay word history. [Collins: Arcadia](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/arcadia)

etymology.historical_story: Ajumma comes from Korean 아줌마 and is a familiar counterpart of ajumeoni, 아주머니. Such terms extend social relationships beyond actual relatives, allowing speakers to address unrelated adults through age and familiarity. The same familiarity can sound dismissive, so the term carries social information as well as a reference to a woman. [National Institute of Korean Language](https://www.korean.go.kr/front/mcfaq/mcfaqView.do?mcfaq_seq=6556&mn_id=44&pageIndex=1)

etymology.historical_story: Ahem represents a small bodily sound used as a social signal: a deliberate clearing of the throat before speaking. Writing gives that sound a recognizable form, so it can attract attention even in a silent message. The supplied dictionary entry establishes this function but does not identify a particular donor language or historical borrowing route.

etymology.historical_story: Alaikum preserves Arabic ʿalaykum, meaning upon you, within a greeting used in Malay Muslim life. Its plural addressee form remains even when one person is greeted. The complete expression wishes peace upon the listener, and the conventional reply returns that wish. Malay spelling commonly joins these expressions as assalamualaikum and waalaikumussalam.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把问候拆成意义块：assalamu 是“平安”，alaikum 是“临于你们”；合起来才是“愿你们平安”。

morphology.pattern_note: 按原包作为完整词根记忆；ng 表示 /ŋ/，不拆读为 /nɡ/。现代感叹用法不宜机械拆为 alang 与疑问小品词 -kah。

senses.zh_definition: 多么……啊；何等……。用于表达赞叹、惊讶或强烈感受。
senses.en_definition: How …! Used to express admiration, surprise, or another strong feeling.
senses.ms_definition: Kata yang melahirkan rasa kagum, hairan dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 属于 kata seru（感叹词），本结构归入 particle。常见句式为 alangkah + 形容词或状态词 + -nya，可表达正面或负面感受。释义依据 [DBP：alangkah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=alangkah)。

senses.zh_definition: 多么；何其。强调某种性质或状态的程度，相当于 betapa；条件句中常表达愿望或惋惜。
senses.en_definition: How; to what a great extent, often expressing a wish when followed by a conditional clause.
senses.ms_definition: Betapa, untuk menyatakan darjah sesuatu sifat atau keadaan.
senses.nuances: 与感叹义密切相关，此处按原包第二义保留程度用法。Alangkah baiknya jika… 表示“要是……就好了”，愿望来自整个句式，并非 alangkah 单独表示“如果”。

etymology.historical_story: Alangkah appears in Malay pantun as well as modern expressions of admiration and longing. DBP records pantun examples using it to introduce an emphatic judgment. This literary presence helps explain its expressive character, although it does not establish the word's ultimate origin. For learners, treating alangkah as a complete exclamatory word avoids mistaking its ending for an ordinary question marker. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=alangkah)

senses.zh_definition: 为保存和查考而收藏的文书、契据或其他档案资料的总称。
senses.en_definition: A collection of documents or records preserved for reference.
senses.ms_definition: Himpunan naskhah, piagam atau rekod yang disimpan untuk rujukan.
senses.nuances: 侧重保存的资料集合，而非建筑物；通常具有历史、行政或研究价值。不能把所有旧物都称为 arkib。

senses.zh_definition: 专门收藏、保管文书、公共记录及历史文件的档案馆或保存场所。
senses.en_definition: A repository where documents, public records and historical materials are preserved.
senses.ms_definition: Tempat menyimpan dan memelihara naskhah, rekod awam serta dokumen sejarah.
senses.nuances: 指保存场所或机构；Arkib Negara Malaysia 是机构专名，须大写。与 muzium 有别：前者侧重档案记录，后者主要展示和收藏文物。

senses.zh_definition: 计算机中用于长期保存程序或数据的存储处。
senses.en_definition: A storage repository for the long-term retention of computer programs or data.
senses.ms_definition: Tempat penyimpanan atur cara dan data komputer untuk tempoh yang panjang.
senses.nuances: 用于计算机和数字资料语境。arkib 本身是名词；正式表达“进行归档”时使用 mengarkib 或 mengarkibkan。归档不一定涉及压缩，也不完全等同于备份。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 中性正式词，适用于行政、学术及日常数字资料交流。提及具体机构时使用其完整名称，例如 Arkib Negara Malaysia。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 谈档案时区分“保存资料”与“公开资料”；称为 arkib 并不意味着任何人都能查阅。请求工作人员协助时可说：Boleh saya mendapatkan bantuan untuk mencari rekod ini?

etymology.historical_story: Malaysia's archival institution began as the Public Records Office on 1 December 1957. This gives arkib a concrete cultural association: preserving the nation's documentary memory. Its dictionary meanings cover both preserved records and their repository, including computer storage. This institutional history does not establish the word's precise borrowing route. [Source: Arkib Negara Malaysia](https://www.arkib.gov.my/images/penerbitan/edaran%20awam/laporan%20tahunan/LAPORAN%20TAHUNAN%20ANM%202023.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 arkib 与英语 archive 配对记忆：一盒旧文件、一座档案馆、一个数字保存库，共同核心都是“保存以备查考”。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，不拆成马来语词缀；e 为 é（/e/），g 读 /ɡ/。资料包的 syllables 为 null；DBP 标音分节为 a.lér.gi。

senses.zh_definition: 过敏；身体对特定食物、药物或其他物质异常敏感，并可能因此出现不良健康反应的状态。
senses.en_definition: Allergy; hypersensitivity to a particular substance that can cause an adverse bodily reaction.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan sensitif terhadap sesuatu, seperti makanan atau ubat, sehingga boleh menimbulkan kesan yang tidak baik pada kesihatan; alahan.
senses.nuances: 与 alahan 同义。alergi 指过敏状态，alergen 指引发过敏的物质；不宜把单纯不喜欢某种食物直接说成医学意义上的 alergi。口语 Saya alergi terhadap udang 表示“我对虾过敏”。词义依据：[DBP：alergi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=alergi)。

etymology.historical_story: The international terminology behind alergi reaches back to Clemens von Pirquet, who introduced allergy in 1906 to describe altered bodily reactivity. His original concept was broader than today's usual meaning. Malay records alergi alongside alahan, connecting international medical vocabulary with a familiar Malay equivalent. The precise borrowing route into Malay is not established here. [Historical study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17136331/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 alergi 与英语 allergy 联记：同一医学概念；再配对记住 alergi = alahan。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为专名整词记忆。输入中的 root_word＝all、is_root＝false 缺乏构词依据，已校正；Allan 不能分析成 all 加马来语后缀 -an。所列 IPA 为常见英语读法，具体姓名以本人读法为准。

senses.nuances: 规范写作 Allan，不是表示“全部”的英语 all 的马来语派生形式。以下搭配是人名的常用句法组合，不代表某位特定人物；中文译名应以本人惯用形式为准。[Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/allan)。

etymology.historical_story: Allan belongs to the name family associated with Alan. Alan was established in Brittany centuries before Breton settlers brought it to England after the Norman Conquest. Its ultimate meaning remains uncertain, so attractive translations should not be treated as established facts. The spelling Allan identifies a personal name rather than a Malay suffix formation. [Allan](https://www.behindthename.com/name/allan), [Alan](https://www.behindthename.com/name/alan-1).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Allan 与“艾伦”这个人联系起来：看到双 l 就认名字，不拆成 all＋-an。

etymology.historical_story: Ae illustrates how dialect writing can preserve local speech outside standard spelling. DBP examples from Johor and Pahang use ae where their standard Malay equivalents have air. This supports a regional water meaning, although it does not establish a separate standard headword, a single pronunciation, or a dated account of how the form developed.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ae 与 air＝水配对记忆：看到 isi ae，就想成 isi air＝装水。此处不是英语字母缩写。

morphology.pattern_note: 连续字母可表示声音延长，不能直接分析成三个音节。若记录拖长的 a 音，可近似实现为 [aː]，但没有可由该字符串唯一确定的标准 IPA。is_root 沿用数据包，仅表示未分析出词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 非规范的语音记录形式，可用于表示说话者犹豫、思考或寻找措辞时发出的拖长填充音，近似“呃……”。
senses.en_definition: An informal transcription of a drawn-out hesitation sound used while thinking or searching for words.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan tidak baku yang boleh mewakili bunyi pengisi ketika penutur teragak-agak atau mencari perkataan.
senses.nuances: 此处暂按话语粒子归类，实际更接近填充音，不是已确认的规范词条。数据包没有 DBP 释义、标准音节或爪夷文，不能据此标记为 official。研究转写中可见其作为填充音出现；这不证明其具有固定词义。“yes”和“I”的提示不足以建立“是”或“我”的义项；也不应自动等同于大写缩写 AAA。以下搭配是示例性话语组合，并非已核实的高频固定搭配。[UPSI：访谈转写实例](https://ejournal.upsi.edu.my/index.php/JPB/article/download/7197/3704/32781)

etymology.historical_story: Unlike a conventional dictionary headword, aaa can be a writer's attempt to capture a hesitation sound. Repeating the letter suggests duration rather than a new grammatical formation. Such spellings occur in speech transcripts, but their interpretation depends on the recording and context. The supplied evidence does not establish a historical borrowing, standardized pronunciation, or separate meanings equivalent to yes or I.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到拖长的 aaa…，想象说话者拉长“啊／呃”来争取思考时间；这是记忆提示，不是固定读音规则。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词记忆；au 为双元音，不按英语读音处理。没有可供现代马来语分析的词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 某个人、事物或场所周围令人感受到的微妙气氛、气质或感染力。
senses.en_definition: A subtle atmosphere, character, or impression perceived as surrounding a person, place, or thing.
senses.ms_definition: Suasana atau perasaan halus yang menyelubungi diri seseorang atau sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 可描述个人魅力、威严、神秘感及场所氛围，不一定涉及超自然观念。aura positif 等说法表达主观感受，不表示测量所得的物理能量。[DBP：aura](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=aura)

senses.zh_definition: 医学上的先兆：在某些神经系统发作开始时或之前出现的主观感觉或短暂神经症状，如偏头痛先兆或癫痫先兆。
senses.en_definition: A subjective sensation or transient neurological symptom occurring before or at the onset of a migraine or epileptic seizure.
senses.ms_definition: Gejala deria atau neurologi sementara yang dialami sebelum atau pada permulaan serangan tertentu, seperti migrain atau sawan epilepsi.
senses.nuances: 属于医学专门义，与日常所说的个人气场不同。此处马来文为根据术语资料综合编写的释义，并非《Kamus Dewan》普通义的原文。[DBP 医学术语资料](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=dirasakan)；[Merriam-Webster：aura](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/aura)

etymology.historical_story: The international word aura has a classical ancestry: Latin aura meant a breeze or breath of air and came from Greek. That image helps explain the later sense of an intangible atmosphere surrounding someone. Malay records this atmospheric meaning, while medical terminology uses the same form for particular sensations associated with an attack. The immediate borrowing route into Malay is not established here. [Source](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/aura)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 au-ra，想象一个人周围有一圈看不见却感受得到的气氛；医学义另外记作“发作先兆”。

morphology.pattern_note: 这是英语整词，不是已确认的马来语词根。音标为英语读音；音节及爪夷文沿用输入的 null。不可按马来语字母对应关系读成 /aɲ/，也不附加马来语词缀来编造词族。

senses.zh_definition: 英语限定用法：一些、任何数量的；常用于疑问、否定或条件结构，具体马来语译法随句式而变。
senses.en_definition: English: an unspecified number or amount, especially in questions, negatives, and conditional clauses.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris yang merujuk kepada bilangan atau jumlah yang tidak ditentukan; padanannya bergantung pada konteks, misalnya apa-apa atau sebarang.
senses.nuances: 属于英语词条及混语识别资料，不标记为正式马来语词。此处 adjective 沿用传统词典分类；现代语法通常称 determiner。any 本身不表示否定，须结合 not 等结构理解。下列 ms 项为马来语对应表达。[Cambridge：any](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/any)；[DBP 英马词典资料](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=mana+pun)

senses.zh_definition: 英语自由选择用法：任何一个、无论哪一个，不限定具体对象。
senses.en_definition: English: whichever person or thing is chosen, without restriction.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris yang menunjukkan pilihan tanpa menetapkan orang atau benda tertentu; padanannya termasuk mana-mana atau sesiapa sahaja.
senses.nuances: 强调选择不受限制，不必然表示每一个成员都实际参与。省略后接名词时，英语 any 也可作代词；给定 pos 枚举没有 pronoun，故在此说明，不将其误标为马来语名词。[Cambridge 语法：Any](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/any%3A)

senses.zh_definition: 英语程度副词：丝毫、再有一点；常用于疑问或否定结构，修饰比较级。
senses.en_definition: English: to any degree or extent, often modifying a comparative in a question or negative clause.
senses.ms_definition: Kata adverba bahasa Inggeris yang menunjukkan darjah atau takat, lazimnya bersama bentuk perbandingan dalam ayat tanya atau ayat negatif.
senses.nuances: 例如 any better 是否有所好转、not any faster 不能再快。马来语通常通过整句表达程度关系，不逐字硬译 any。以下搭配为对应的马来语结构。[Cambridge：any](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/any)

etymology.historical_story: English any descends through Middle English from Old English ǣnig, a form related to the word for one. Its modern uses cover unrestricted choice, unspecified quantities, and degree. In Malaysian bilingual conversation it can appear inside English phrases, but that appearance alone does not establish it as a standard Malay borrowing. Malay translations must follow the sentence rather than one fixed equivalent. [Source](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/any)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按英语读近“诶尼”：选择时记 mana-mana，疑问或否定时看整句；不要把 any 固定背成“没有”。

etymology.historical_story: J. K. Rowling explains that Azkaban combines inspiration from Alcatraz, the real island prison, and Abaddon, a Hebrew name associated with destruction or hell. The invented name therefore joins physical isolation with supernatural dread. Malay retains it as a proper name rather than translating it or analysing it into Malay affixes. [Rowling's account](https://www.harrypotter.com/writing-by-jk-rowling/azkaban).

etymology.historical_story: Amir comes from Arabic amīr, a commander or leader, associated with the root meaning to command. Malay preserves it in religious and administrative titles, including expressions for pilgrimage leadership. A particularly local historical use designated the Sultan of Riau's representative in Pulau Tujuh, showing how an Arabic leadership term acquired a specific regional office. [Arabic background](https://www.iranicaonline.org/articles/amir-commander-governor-prince-in-arabic/?generate_pdf=1); [Malay senses](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=amir).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: a.mir → 阿米尔：想象领队举手发令，抓住“统领、指挥”的核心；大写 Amir 出现在姓名位置时，先理解为人名。

etymology.historical_story: Malay arkitek is borrowed from English architect. Its deeper history leads through French and Latin to Greek arkhitektōn, meaning a master builder. That image connects the person designing a building with someone directing a larger undertaking. Malay also uses arkitek figuratively for a principal planner, including the person behind a success. [Malay etymology](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/arkitek), [historical derivation](https://www.etymonline.com/word/architect).

etymology.historical_story: The word ultimately joins Greek autos, meaning self, with graphein, meaning to write. That combination explains why an autograf can be more than a celebrity signature: it can also be an author's handwritten manuscript. Malay autograph albums extend the same idea into personal remembrance, preserving friends' messages alongside names. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=autograf)

etymology.historical_story: Central Maluku has several related names for traditional settlements and communities. Comparative linguistic research records amane alongside forms such as amanno and yamano. These regional connections explain why the spelling appears in discussions of Maluku society, but they do not establish it as standard Malaysian Malay. Its precise identification in this packet remains unresolved. See [the comparative study](https://openresearch-repository.anu.edu.au/server/api/core/bitstreams/87cbfdb6-71ca-4bbc-b179-aadcf0cddb4d/content).
