etymology.historical_story: Aspirin began as a pharmaceutical trade name associated with Bayer's acetylsalicylic acid. Its name links the acetyl component with Spiraea, the former botanical genus of meadowsweet, a plant connected with the history of salicylates. In Malay, aspirin is recorded as an ordinary medicine noun and is learned as a whole borrowed word rather than a Malay affix construction. [Uppsala Monitoring Centre: The Dawn of Drug Safety](https://who-umc.org/media/2531/thedawnofdrugsafety.pdf)

word_family.gloss: 各个方面；整词重叠形式

senses.zh_definition: 观察、讨论或评估某事物时所着眼的一个方面、层面或角度。
senses.en_definition: A particular side, feature, or dimension of something considered from a specific viewpoint.
senses.ms_definition: Segi atau sudut pandangan yang digunakan untuk meneliti atau mempertimbangkan sesuatu perkara.
senses.nuances: 常见于报告、讨论和分析，可与 keselamatan、ekonomi、teknikal 等领域词搭配。dari aspek 与 dari segi 都可引出观察角度；具体指原因时不宜一律以 aspek 代替 faktor。

senses.zh_definition: 语法中的体：从动作或状态的进行、完成、持续等角度描述其时间进程的范畴。
senses.en_definition: The grammatical category describing how an action or state unfolds in time, including its completion or continuation.
senses.ms_definition: Kategori tatabahasa yang menerangkan tahap atau perjalanan sesuatu perbuatan atau keadaan, seperti sudah selesai atau masih berlangsung.
senses.nuances: 属于语言学术语。马来语教学中的 kata bantu aspek 包括 sudah、sedang、masih、belum 等；不能简单理解为动词词形变化所表示的时态。[DBP 语法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=aspek)

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于会议、论文、新闻和有条理的日常讨论。亲友聊天也能使用，但谈简单事情时，segi 往往更轻便；不要堆叠抽象词而不说明具体是哪一方面。

etymology.historical_story: Aspek belongs to an international word family represented by English aspect. That family's Latin ancestor, aspectus, referred to looking or appearance. The connection offers a useful image: turn an object and another side comes into view. In Malay analytical writing, aspek similarly selects one side of an issue, such as cost, safety, or education. [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/aspect)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: aspek 对应英语 aspect：像转动一个盒子，每转一下就看到另一个“方面”。

headword.verification_note: 这是英语不定代词，不能据此标为官方马来语词条。syllables 按要求保留数据包原值，但 not translated 是无效占位文本，并非音节；英语分音节可表示为 an·y·thing。为避免词性错误，senses.pos 使用 pronoun，超出所给枚举。排名仅沿用数据包。

morphology.formula: any + thing → anything（英语复合词；无马来语词缀）
morphology.pattern_note: is_root 沿用数据包，仅表示在马来语分析中不作词缀派生。英语内部可辨认 any 和 thing；词尾 -ing 在这里不是动词后缀。

senses.zh_definition: 任何东西或事情；常用于疑问、否定和条件语境，指未具体指定的事物。
senses.en_definition: An unspecified thing, especially in questions, negatives, and conditional clauses.
senses.ms_definition: Kata ganti nama bahasa Inggeris bagi sesuatu perkara atau benda yang tidak ditentukan; padanannya dalam bahasa Melayu bergantung pada konteks, seperti apa-apa atau sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 这是英语义项。否定句中的 not ... anything 通常对应 tidak ... apa-apa；条件句中常对应 apa-apa。不能机械地把每次出现都译成任何。马来文释义为编辑说明，并非 DBP 对 anything 的官方释义；搭配栏中的 ms 保留被解释的英语短语，不表示这些是标准马来语搭配。

senses.zh_definition: 无论什么；随便哪一样，表示选择不受限制。
senses.en_definition: Any thing whatsoever, without restriction on the choice.
senses.ms_definition: Apa-apa sahaja tanpa mengehadkan pilihan kepada benda atau perkara tertentu.
senses.nuances: 英语独立回答 Anything 可表示“什么都行”。马来语日常可说 Apa-apa pun boleh。语气过于简短时，可能显得对对方的安排不够投入；表达感谢会更周到。搭配栏中的 ms 为英语目标短语。

dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam terjemahan bahasa Melayu, perkataan Inggeris 'anything' hendaklah diterjemahkan mengikut konteks ayat.

dual_scenarios.en: When translating into Malay, the English word 'anything' should be rendered according to the sentence context.

etymology.historical_story: Anything is an English compound joining any with thing. Its meaning changes with context: a question may ask whether something exists, while a statement may allow an unrestricted choice. Within a Malay conversation, retaining the English word creates a language switch. That conversational use alone does not establish it as an official Malay headword.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: any“任意”＋ thing“事物”＝ anything；记住问句“有什么吗”、否定句“什么也没有”、选择句“什么都行”这三个语境。

morphology.formula: Asia + Afrika → AA（首字母缩写；检索键为 aa）
morphology.pattern_note: 这不是词缀派生。资料包的小写 aa 对应词典大写缩写 AA；音标表示按马来西亚常用字母名称逐字母读出，实际也可展开读作 Asia-Afrika。

senses.zh_definition: Asia-Afrika 的首字母缩写，意为“亚洲—非洲”或“亚非”。
senses.en_definition: An initialism of Asia-Afrika, meaning Asia–Africa or Asian–African.
senses.ms_definition: Kependekan bagi Asia-Afrika.
senses.nuances: 规范书写为 AA；词性 noun 在此表示具有名词性指称的缩写。此义由 [PRPM：AA](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=AA) 支持。资料包中“相当于 -lah”的提示不属于这一缩写义，不宜合并；聊天中的 aa 也不能脱离语境一律解释为亚非。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 本词没有特殊敬语限制。正式文本首次出现时宜先写 Asia-Afrika (AA)，让读者明确缩写所指。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: AA 在其他语境中可能另有所指；聊天中的小写 aa 还可能只是声音或语气的书写。只有上下文明确时，才采用本条的亚非义。

etymology.historical_story: AA takes the initial letters of Asia and Afrika. Its historical setting includes the Asian–African Conference held in Bandung in 1955, which brought representatives of Asian and African countries together. That event helps explain the cultural resonance of Asia–Africa cooperation, but it does not establish when this particular Malay abbreviation was first coined. See the [Indonesian National Archives guide](https://www.anri.go.id/download/guide-arsip-tematis-konferensi-asia-afrika-english-1619486584).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 两个 A，两个地区：Asia 的 A 加 Afrika 的 A，就是 AA（亚非）。

morphology.formula: ∅ + ascot → ascot（英语服饰名称，整词记忆）
morphology.pattern_note: 不能拆成马来语词根与词缀；sc 也不是马来语词缀。音标采用英语英式读音，不宣称存在已核定的马来语标准读音。

senses.zh_definition: 阿斯科特式领巾或宽领带：围在颈部、两端交叠的宽幅领饰，可置于敞开的衬衫领内，也有用于礼服的款式。
senses.en_definition: A broad neck scarf or cravat worn with its ends overlapping, either inside an open shirt collar or as formal neckwear.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis kain leher atau tali leher lebar yang dipakai mengelilingi leher dengan kedua-dua hujungnya bertindih, sama ada di dalam kolar terbuka atau bersama pakaian rasmi.
senses.nuances: 此处采用英语服饰名词义；大写 Ascot 也可为地名或名称，不能自动套用本义。资料包没有提供 DBP 释义，故本条马来语释义为编辑性说明，status 沿用指定字段，不构成 DBP 收录证明。定义及英式读音参见 [Oxford：ascot](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/ascot)；款式范围参见 [OQLF：ascot](https://vitrinelinguistique.oqlf.gouv.qc.ca/fiche-gdt/fiche/2072653/ascot)。以下为服饰语境中的自然组合。

etymology.historical_story: Ascot takes its name from the English town associated with a famous annual horse-racing meeting. Fashionable dress at those meetings supplied the connection between the place and the neckwear. The garment name consequently preserves a social setting in its vocabulary. Its use in a Malay sentence is best understood here as an English fashion term. See [Oxford's word history](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/ascot).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“Ascot 赛马盛会上的颈饰”：地名变服饰名，ascot 就是那种宽宽交叠的领巾。

etymology.historical_story: Abigail comes from a Hebrew personal name commonly interpreted as 'my father is joy'. A biblical bearer was the wife of Nabal and later of David. English usage helped circulate the name internationally, alongside familiar forms such as Abby. These are naming traditions, not evidence of a Malay derivational family. [Behind the Name：Abigail](https://www.behindthename.com/name/abigail)

etymology.historical_story: Aww is an expressive spelling of English aw, representing a vocal reaction rather than a word built from Malay roots. The expression can convey tenderness, sympathy, disappointment, or disapproval. In a Malay chat, it can function as an English insertion alongside Malay grammar. Extra letters visually prolong the reaction; they do not create a new Malay affix or a reliably different meaning.

etymology.historical_story: English awesome combines awe with the adjective-forming suffix -some. Its sense of inspiring wonder, respect, or fear survives alongside the informal meaning excellent. In a Malay conversation, the word can function as an English insertion conveying enthusiastic approval; that use does not by itself establish official Malay lexical status. morphology.formula: ada → [a.də] → ade（口语读音的非规范拼写）
morphology.pattern_note: ade 是 ada 的口语拼写，不是添加词缀产生的新词。部分马来语变体把词尾开放音节中的 /a/ 读为 [ə]；规范拼写仍为 ada。按输入保留 root_word 为 ade，以下词族实际以 ada 为基础。

senses.zh_definition: 有；存在；在某处或可以取得。为 ada 的非规范口语拼写。
senses.en_definition: An informal spelling of ada: to exist, be present, or be available.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan tidak baku bagi ada dalam percakapan atau mesej tidak rasmi, bermaksud wujud, hadir atau tersedia.
senses.nuances: ade 末尾的 e 在此表示央元音 [ə]，并非必然读作 [e]。这种发音不代表规范书写也应改成 ade。[相关语音研究](https://tufs.repo.nii.ac.jp/record/1438/files/07Inagaki.pdf)。

senses.zh_definition: 拥有；有某物、时间或条件。为 ada 表示领有关系时的非规范写法。
senses.en_definition: An informal spelling of ada meaning to have or possess.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan tidak baku bagi ada yang membawa maksud mempunyai atau memiliki sesuatu.
senses.nuances: Saya ade masa 对应 Saya ada masa，意思是“我有空”。ade 不能在所有表示“是”的句子中代替系词。

senses.zh_definition: 放在动词前，表示确实发生过某事或曾有相关经历；是 ada 的非规范口语写法。
senses.en_definition: An informal spelling of preverbal ada, indicating that an event did occur or has been experienced.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan tidak baku bagi ada yang digunakan sebelum kata kerja untuk menyatakan bahawa sesuatu perbuatan memang berlaku atau pernah dilakukan.
senses.nuances: 这里按语用功能归为 particle，并非表示独立的时间词。Saya ade dengar 表示“我有听说”，具体时间仍由上下文决定。

etymology.historical_story: Ade is best understood as speech reflected in writing, rather than as a separate inherited word. In schwa varieties of Malay, a final open-syllable a can surface as [ə]. Informal writers represent that familiar sound with e, while standard orthography retains ada. The distinction is between pronunciation and spelling. [Related phonological research](https://tufs.repo.nii.ac.jp/record/1438/files/07Inagaki.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Akio represents a Japanese name reading rather than one uniquely defined written word. Different kanji combinations can share this pronunciation, so a romanized occurrence does not establish a single meaning. When the name appears in Malay, identifying its bearer and original spelling is more reliable than assigning an attractive but unsupported translation. [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/akio)

senses.zh_definition: 考古学：通过发掘、记录和分析文化遗存，科学研究过去人类文化，尤其是史前文化的学科。
senses.en_definition: The scientific study of past human cultures, especially prehistoric cultures, through the excavation and analysis of material remains.
senses.ms_definition: Kajian saintifik mengenai sesuatu kebudayaan, terutama kebudayaan prasejarah, dengan cara penggalian dan penghuraian kesan-kesan tinggalannya; kaji purba.
senses.nuances: 指研究人类文化遗存的学科；研究者称 ahli arkeologi。并非仅指挖掘，也不等于研究恐龙化石的古生物学。马来语释义据《Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat》展开缩写。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=arkeologi)

etymology.historical_story: Arkeologi belongs to an international scholarly vocabulary ultimately connected with Greek arkhaiologia, an account of antiquity. Its modern meaning centres on investigating past cultures through material evidence. In Malaysian heritage work, that investigation includes surveying, excavation, documentation and analysis: a potsherd matters because its recorded surroundings help explain the people who used it. [Académie française](https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9A2405), [Jabatan Warisan Negara](https://www.heritage.gov.my/en/kraf.html?catid=17%3Ainfo-jwn&id=34%3Abahagian-arkeologi&view=article)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 arkeologi 与英语 archaeology 配对：看到古陶片，就想到研究古人生活的“考古学”；按 ar-ke-o-lo-gi 五拍读。

etymology.historical_story: No reliable historical origin can be assigned to this isolated spelling from the available evidence. Informal messages allow writers to represent sighs and cries with variable letters, but resemblance alone cannot establish a Malay etymology. Here, the useful cultural lesson is to distinguish an expressive written sound from a documented dictionary word.

etymology.historical_story: Anwar comes from an Arabic personal name meaning brighter or more luminous, related to nur, light. In Malay usage, it functions as a person's name rather than a descriptive adjective. Its presence illustrates how Arabic names became part of Muslim naming traditions while retaining their identity as complete names in the receiving language.

morphology.pattern_note: 词根无音变，直接添加使动后缀 -kan，音节为 a.sing.kan。按要求保留包内 jawi，但 اسيڠ 实际是词根 asing；完整 asingkan 写作 اسيڠکن。

word_family.gloss: 分离；隔离的行为或状态

senses.zh_definition: 把某物与其他事物分开，或按种类、性质等分别放置。
senses.en_definition: To separate something from other things, including sorting items into distinct groups.
senses.ms_definition: Memisahkan sesuatu daripada yang lain.
senses.nuances: asingkan 常用于祈使句，如 Sila asingkan kertas ini；也用于第一、第二人称被动结构，如 Dokumen itu saya asingkan。一般规范主动陈述用 mengasingkan。不能把词根 asing 的“外国的”直接套用于此动词。释义依据 [DBP：mengasingkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mengasingkan)。

senses.zh_definition: 使某人与其他人分开或隔离；与 diri 连用时表示使自己独处、远离他人。
senses.en_definition: To isolate or keep someone apart from others; with diri, to withdraw or seclude oneself.
senses.ms_definition: Menjauhkan seseorang daripada orang lain; memencilkan.
senses.nuances: 可指实际分开，也可指社交上的孤立。asingkan diri 的主语把自己与他人分开；若表示“感到疏离”，通常用 berasa terasing。对人的隔离和物品分类应按语境区分。

senses.zh_definition: 把某人安置或放逐到与外界分隔、偏远的地方。
senses.en_definition: To place or banish someone in a remote or isolated location.
senses.ms_definition: Menempatkan atau membuang seseorang ke tempat yang terpisah atau terpencil.
senses.nuances: 此义常见于历史上的放逐、流放叙述。一般陈述采用 mengasingkan，受事叙述常用 diasingkan；asingkan 本身可用于相应祈使句。

etymology.historical_story: Asingkan makes the idea of being separate into an action through the suffix -kan. The same word can organise household objects or describe keeping people apart, giving context a decisive role. Malaysia's public information campaign Asingkan Demi Masa Depan Anak-Anak Kita uses this direct imperative to promote waste separation. [Jabatan Penerangan Malaysia](https://dbook.penerangan.gov.my/dbook/dmdocuments/asingkan_demi_masa_depan_anak_kita/files/downloads/Asingkan%20Demi%20Masa%20Depan%20anak%20Anak%20Kita.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: asing＝分开的，-kan＝使……如此：asingkan 就是“把它分开”。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 是附着成分，此处通常回指前文的一组对象；ny 表示单一辅音 /ɲ/。资料包的 انتارا 是词根拼写，完整 antaranya 写作 انتاراڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 其中；在前文提到的一组人、事物或事项之中，用于指出部分成员或例子。
senses.en_definition: Among them; used to identify members or examples from a previously mentioned group.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam kalangan atau lingkungan orang, benda atau perkara yang telah disebut, dengan menyatakan sebahagian daripadanya.
senses.nuances: antara 保留介词性质，-nya 回指前文对象；在列举结构中，整段也可起补充说明的作用。通常只列举部分项目，不表示清单已经完整。前文须有明确或可推知的集合。[DBP：antaranya 的列举用例](https://dewanmasyarakat.jendeladbp.my/2026/10/20/40665/)

senses.zh_definition: 所指对象之间的距离、空隙或时间间隔；常见于表示相隔不久等结构。

etymology.historical_story: Antaranya shows how a small attached form can organize an entire explanation. Antara supplies the idea of a position within or between things, while -nya points back to something already understood. In reports and conversation, the combination lets speakers move from a broad group to selected examples without repeating the group’s full name.

etymology.historical_story: Alec belongs to the English naming tradition as a short form of Alexander. etymology.historical_story: Álvarez originated as a patronymic surname associated with the personal name Álvaro. The historical ending -ez expressed descent, conventionally explained as 'son of Álvaro'. Today, the surname is inherited and does not identify the bearer's father's given name. Its historical components are not productive affixes in Malay. [Enciclopedia Galega Universal](https://egu.xunta.gal/es/termo/72639/alvarez).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Alvarez 整体对应“阿尔瓦雷斯”；历史上的 -ez 可联想到家族传承，现代马来语中仍整词记忆。

etymology.historical_story: AB is formed from the initials of anggaran belanja, rather than inherited as an ordinary spoken word. Its structure reflects the economy of administrative writing: a two-word financial expression becomes a compact document label. Kamus Dewan records this expansion, but does not supply a date of coinage or identify an individual who introduced it. [DBP dictionary](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=ab)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: A 对应 Anggaran（估算），B 对应 Belanja（开支）：AB 就是先估算要花多少钱；读作 é-bi。

etymology.historical_story: Achilles belongs to the Greek mythological tradition rather than Malay word formation. His stories travelled beyond Greece: an Etruscan bronze mirror from the third century BCE labels him Achle. That surviving object illustrates how a hero's name could cross languages long before modern readers encountered Achilles in literature or anatomical terminology. [Metropolitan Museum](https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/251054)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 Achilles，想起阿喀琉斯；看到 tendon Achilles，就把英雄的名字定位到脚后方的跟腱。

etymology.historical_story: Arteri belongs to an international medical vocabulary whose historical relatives include Latin arteria and Greek artēria. Earlier anatomical terminology connected these vessels with air passages; modern anatomy identifies them by blood flowing away from the heart. This international history does not establish which language directly supplied the Malay form. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/artery).

etymology.historical_story: Asano is documented as a Japanese family name in an international undersea naming proposal. Such names can occur unchanged inside Malay reports without becoming Malay common nouns. However, the packet supplies only a lowercase token, so this identification remains conditional. Neither its original Japanese characters nor a particular family history can responsibly be reconstructed from these letters alone.

etymology.historical_story: The spelling ala brings several histories together. DBP links its conversational exclamation to alah, identifies Arabic senses associated with expressions such as ala kadar and classical terala, and traces the stylistic use to French. A restaurant description and a friend's coaxing remark can therefore contain identical letters without expressing the same meaning or sharing the same immediate origin. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ala)

etymology.historical_story: Amit shows why identical spellings need not share one history. DBP labels amit I as Javanese and explains its derivative pengamitan through a newlywed's gift to the parents-in-law when leaving their home. Separately, amit II is labeled Sarawak and means a light snack. The dictionary establishes these regional distinctions; it does not establish a common origin linking the wedding custom and food meanings. [DBP dictionary](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=amit)

etymology.historical_story: English angel ultimately comes from Greek angelos, meaning messenger, through Latin and French transmission, with an Old English borrowing also contributing to its history. Religious usage made the divine messenger its central image. Later figurative uses extended that image to helpful people and financial supporters. Angels adds the ordinary English plural ending. [Oxford English Dictionary](https://doi.org/10.1093/OED/1018017422)

etymology.historical_story: Ariadne belongs to the Greek mythological tradition. Ancient accounts tell how she helped Theseus escape the Labyrinth with a thread, giving the name a memorable connection with finding a path through confusion. Malay texts can preserve this foreign proper name when discussing mythology or literature; its letters do not represent a Malay root-and-affix construction. [Source](https://www.theoi.com/Georgikos/Ariadne.html)

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates Malay’s productive word building: arah provides the base, -an forms the noun arahan, and attached -nya identifies the person associated with the direction or instructions. The dictionary records both supervision and commands under arahan. The surface form is therefore explainable through Malay morphology without inventing a separate borrowing history for arahannya. [Source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=250764&keyword=arahan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: arah“方向” → arahan“给出的方向、指示” → arahannya“他或她的指示”。末尾 nya 提醒你追问：谁的？

etymology.historical_story: Asuhan is transparently formed from asuh with the noun-forming suffix -an. Its dictionary meanings connect everyday care with education and guidance, so upbringing and mentorship belong to the same lexical family. The expression taman asuhan kanak-kanak places this connection in institutional childcare: caring for children includes helping them develop, rather than merely watching over them. [DBP: asuh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=asuh)

etymology.historical_story: Agnes comes through Latin from Greek Hagne, associated with purity or chastity. The name spread widely in Christian naming traditions through Saint Agnes. etymology.historical_story: Aragorn is a Sindarin name within Tolkien’s invented linguistic world. Tolkien’s explanation, published in 2007 from an earlier manuscript, interprets it as ‘revered king’, combining a reduced form of aran with an adjective expressing dread or reverence. This fictional etymology enriches the character’s royal identity, but it must not be presented as Malay word formation. [Tolkien Gateway](https://tolkiengateway.net/wiki/Aragorn#Etymology)

etymology.historical_story: Anjingku illustrates Malay's compact possessive grammar: the animal name anjing combines with -ku, the bound form of aku. The same pattern produces rumahku and bukuku. Its meaning therefore comes from a productive grammatical construction, rather than a separate lexical origin. The attached pronoun identifies the speaker as possessor without changing the animal noun. See [DBP: ku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ku).

etymology.historical_story: AD comes from the initial letters of the Indonesian institutional term Angkatan Darat. The letters preserve the two-word name in a compact form, especially within TNI AD. Its dictionary label points to Indonesian usage, helping Malaysian readers recognise a neighbouring country's terminology. The abbreviation therefore carries institutional and regional context, rather than a history of Malay affixation. [Indonesian Army glossary](https://www.tniad.mil.id/images/pdf_buku/buku-peranan-tni-ad.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: A 1984 issue of Sekata presents amarah becoming marah as an example of apheresis: the loss of a sound at the beginning of a word. This offers a memorable historical connection between the two forms. It does not establish the word's ultimate source language, and the initial a should not be treated as a productive modern Malay prefix. [Sekata, April 1984](https://www.languagecouncils.sg/mbms/my/-/media/mlc/documents/pdfs/sekata/1984_bilangan-1.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Alahan shows why identical spellings need not share one meaning. Malay dictionaries record water-related senses alongside allergy and defeat-related senses. Its visible formation is alah plus -an, but the relevant meaning of alah must be identified separately. For learners, the important historical lesson is to preserve these distinct lexical branches rather than invent one story connecting rivers, allergies, and losing. [DBP entries](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=alahan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先看邻词再选义：makanan、ubat 指向过敏；alur sungai、tebat 指向水道；kalah、berjudi 指向落败。

etymology.historical_story: Alabama preserves an Indigenous name rather than a Malay descriptive expression. The state took its name from the Alabama River, which was named for the Alabama people. The name's deeper literal meaning remains debated. Alabama's archives caution that the familiar interpretation meaning a place to rest lacks linguistic support; the people-to-river-to-state connection is better established. [Alabama Archives](https://www.archives.alabama.gov/research/guidance/Fast-Facts.aspx)

etymology.historical_story: Ajal is borrowed from Arabic ajal, a term for an appointed period or its endpoint. Qur'anic usage connects this idea with the time allotted to a community. In Malay, the word centres on life's appointed end, preserving a religious understanding of mortality in everyday expressions and solemn writing. Sources: [Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/ajal#Malay), [Quran 7:34](https://quran.com/en/7/34), [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?keyword=ajal).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: a.jal 两拍联想“啊，终点到了”：ajal 是生命的终点、死期；只是记忆联想，并非词源。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 地名和人名均写作 Austin。正式报告首次提及城市时写 Austin, Texas，可减少与人物或其他同名地点混淆。

etymology.historical_story: Austin belongs to a European personal-name tradition associated with Augustine and Latin Augustinus. Its appearance in Malay normally preserves the identity of a person or place. The Texas city received its name in honour of Stephen F. Austin in 1839, illustrating how a surname can become a geographical name. References: [Medieval Names Dictionary](https://dmnes.org/2017/1/name/Austin), [Texas State Historical Association](https://www.tshaonline.org/handbook/entries/austin-tx-travis-county).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Austin → 奥斯汀：先看上下文，bandar 或 Texas 提示城市，Encik 提示人物；不要硬拆成马来语词根。

morphology.pattern_note: au 感叹词整体发音，不加词缀；Au 是化学符号，不作马来语词根拆分。headword.ipa 对应感叹词，不规定化学符号的读法；科学语境可读出元素名称 emas。

senses.zh_definition: Au：化学元素金的符号，源于拉丁语 aurum；金的原子序数为79。
senses.en_definition: Au, the chemical symbol for gold, the element with atomic number 79.
senses.ms_definition: Simbol kimia bagi aurum.
senses.nuances: 规范写法必须为大写 A 加小写 u：Au。此处 noun 是在指定词性范围内对元素符号的归类，Au 本身不是普通名词词形。不能把感叹词 /au̯/ 的读音直接套用到符号。参见 [DBP：Au／au](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=au) 与 [英国皇家化学学会：Gold](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/79/Gold)。

senses.nuances: DBP 将此义标为 kata seru；因指定词性列表不含 interjection，此处以 particle 容纳。不要与化学符号 Au 混为一义。数据包中的“是、对”提示不足以证明其为标准马来语肯定词，本条不据此增设该义。参见 [DBP：au](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=au)。

etymology.historical_story: Two distinct items meet in this spelling. The chemical symbol Au preserves the opening letters of aurum, the Latin name for gold, rather than the Malay name emas. Lowercase au is separately recorded by DBP as an exclamation of pain, fear or surprise. Their shared letters do not establish a shared origin. Sources: [Geoscience Australia](https://www.ga.gov.au/education/minerals-energy/australian-mineral-facts/gold), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=au).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Au 看前两字母：Aurum＝金；au 听语气：踩到玩具喊“哎哟”。同样两字母，靠大小写和语境分辨。

etymology.historical_story: Alas brings together familiar objects through their supporting function: a cup rests on a saucer, a table receives a covering, and a structure stands on a base. Related forms extend this image to grounds for an opinion. Separately, the dictionary records a Javanese forest homonym, which belongs to a different meaning history. [DBP: alas](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=254640&keyword=alas)

etymology.historical_story: Antonio is a Spanish and Italian continuation of the Roman name Antonius. Its international relatives include Anthony and Antoine, but these are separate naming forms rather than Malay derivatives. The original meaning of Antonius is uncertain, so attractive translations such as 'priceless' should not be presented as established etymology. [Antonio](https://www.behindthename.com/name/antonio), [Antonius](https://www.behindthename.com/name/antonius).

etymology.historical_story: Malay atlet was adapted from English athlete. DBP explains that the standard spelling already appeared in the second edition of Kamus Dewan in 1986. The spelling atlit remains visible enough to generate questions, but its dictionary entry directs readers to atlet. This illustrates how dictionary inclusion can document a form while directing writers toward another spelling. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=atlet)

etymology.historical_story: Ambrose comes through Latin Ambrosius from Greek ambrosios, meaning immortal or divine. The name appears across medieval European records in several forms and is associated with Saint Ambrose, the fourth-century bishop of Milan. In a Malay sentence it identifies a person; its ancient meaning does not function as an ordinary Malay definition. [Sources: etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Ambrose), [historical records](https://dmnes.org/name/Ambrose).

etymology.historical_story: Atlantic carries a classical name into modern geography: its name is associated with Atlas of Greek mythology. etymology.historical_story: Asgard continues the Old Norse name Ásgarðr, conventionally interpreted as the enclosure of the Æsir gods. Its second element refers to an enclosed space or yard, making the name evoke a defended dwelling rather than an abstract heaven. In Norse storytelling, it names the gods' home; modern readers should distinguish that mythological setting from the details of later adaptations. [Etymology and meaning](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/asgard)

etymology.historical_story: The useful cultural story belongs to ambil and the particle -lah, rather than to the unverified spelling ambilah. A simple command to take something becomes an invitation through context and intonation. The same construction extends naturally from offering food to encouraging someone to seize an opportunity. Standard spelling keeps both adjacent letters: ambillah.

etymology.historical_story: Antibiotik belongs to the international scientific vocabulary associated with antibiotic. Its Greek-derived elements evoke opposition to life, referring here to effects on microorganisms. During twentieth-century research, scientists investigated substances made by microbes that inhibited other microbes. Waksman and Woodruff's 1942 paper documents antibiotic terminology during this formative period of modern drug discovery. [Original research](https://journals.asm.org/doi/10.1128/jb.44.3.373-384.1942)

etymology.historical_story: Atlas became a name for a book of maps through Gerard Mercator's work published in 1595. Later mapmakers adopted the title until it became a general cartographic term. etymology.historical_story: Ampunilah brings together ampun, the vocabulary of pardon, the verbal ending -i, and the attached particle -lah. DBP connects the family with both forgiveness and release from punishment. That semantic range helps explain its solemn character: the speaker asks for mercy, rather than merely acknowledging a minor inconvenience. A deeper historical origin is not established here. Source: [DBP：ampun](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ampun).

etymology.historical_story: Arabic is an English language name recorded since the fifteenth century. It names a Semitic language associated with the Arabs and also functions as an adjective for its writing and cultural traditions. In Malaysian multilingual conversation, the English label may appear inside a Malay sentence, while standard Malay uses bahasa Arab. This is code-switching, not a separate Malay derivation. [Historical record](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/Arabic).

etymology.historical_story: Adams is documented as a surname connected with the personal name Adam. etymology.historical_story: Amnesia ultimately comes from Greek amnēsia, meaning forgetfulness. Its history belongs to the international vocabulary of medicine, where Greek forms helped name conditions affecting memory and other mental functions. Malay uses the borrowed term as a whole word. The available evidence does not establish its first Malay occurrence or exact borrowing route. [Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/amnesia)

etymology.historical_story: Arya belongs to a Sanskrit-derived vocabulary of honour and social standing. A government-published study records Malay arya alongside Sanskrit and Javanese forms associated with nobility and respect. In Javanese royal administration, the word became a title for high officials. Its historical title sense therefore carries a specific cultural setting rather than functioning as an everyday Malaysian form of address. [Historical vocabulary study](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/3088/1/KOSAKATA%20BAHASA%20SANSEKERTA%20DALAM%20BAHASA%20MELAYU%20MASA%20KINI.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Anggapan preserves two dictionary traditions under one spelling. In contemporary Malay it usually names an opinion or assumption. In classical literary usage, it can instead mean an invitation, particularly to dance. Both connect to entries spelled anggap, but their shared spelling alone does not establish a historical development from one meaning to the other. [DBP: anggapan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=anggapan)

senses.zh_definition: 宽恕、饶恕犯错或有罪的人；常用于恳求对方施予宽恕。

etymology.historical_story: Ampun has relatives across several languages of the Malay Archipelago, including Iban and Old Javanese. Its associations with mercy help explain its prominence in Malay prayers and royal language. Adding -i directs forgiveness towards its recipient; ampuni therefore becomes a compact appeal to be forgiven. These regional connections are documented in the [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://acd.clld.org/cognatesets/24830).

etymology.historical_story: Ac represents actinium, whose name comes from a Greek word meaning ray. The element is associated with the early investigation of radioactivity: André Debierne reported its discovery in 1899, and Friedrich Giesel independently investigated it soon afterward. Malay uses the adapted name aktinium while retaining the international symbol Ac, allowing scientific notation to remain consistent across languages.

etymology.historical_story: Azrael is an international form of a name associated with the angel of death, with a Hebrew naming background. Malay religious usage commonly employs Izrail. Its cultural familiarity should be distinguished from scriptural attestation: Malaysia's Federal Territories Mufti explains that the name is transmitted in tradition but is not explicitly established in the Quran or authentic hadith. [Mufti explanation](https://muftiwp.gov.my/ms/artikel/al-kafi-li-al-fatawi/1842-al-kafi-li-al-fatawi-ke-463-asal-nama-malaikat-izra-il?templateStyle=16)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Azrael 与马来语常见的 Izrail 配对记忆：两个名称在相关传统中通常指向死亡天使；名称不是马来语词缀组合。

etymology.historical_story: Abdi comes from Arabic ʿabd, a word associated with a servant or slave. Malay adopted it as a complete lexical item, rather than forming it with a native suffix. Its derivatives include mengabdi and pengabdian, which can express service and dedication. Those positive derivative meanings should not erase the headword's historical association with enslavement. [Source: Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/abdi).

etymology.historical_story: Abnegation entered English through Middle English from Late Latin abnegatio, related to Latin abnegare, meaning to deny or refuse. Its history helps explain both personal self-denial and the rejection of responsibility. These meanings share an act of saying no, but their moral colouring changes with what is being refused. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/abnegation)
